19.1.text: Let Your law be my delight, Lord, and let me meditate on it day and night.
Make me like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season.
Thank You that You guard the path of the righteous. Keep me on that path.

19.2.text: Make the rulers of the earth wise and willing to be corrected. Make me the same.
Help me serve You with fear and rejoice with trembling, Lord.
I take refuge in Your Son. Thank You that all who take refuge in Him are blessed.

19.3.text: Thank You, Lord, that You are a shield around me and the One who lifts my head.
Thank You, Lord, that I lie down and sleep and wake again, for You sustain me.
Salvation belongs to You, Lord. Let Your blessing be on Your people.

19.4.text: Answer me when I call, God. Show me grace and hear my prayer.
Thank You that You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
Let me lie down and sleep in peace, Lord, for You alone keep me safe.

19.5.text: Lord, You hear my voice in the morning. At daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait.
Lead me in Your righteousness, Lord, and make Your way straight before me.
Shelter me and all who take refuge in You, that those who love Your name may rejoice.

19.6.text: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I am frail. Heal me, for my bones are in agony.
Turn to me, Lord, and deliver my soul. Save me because of Your loving devotion.
Thank You that You have heard my cry for mercy and accept my prayer.

19.7.text: Lord my God, I take refuge in You. Save me and deliver me from all who pursue me.
You are my shield, God, and You save the upright in heart.
I thank You, Lord, for Your righteousness, and I sing praise to Your name, Lord Most High.

19.8.text: Lord, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! I praise You.
When I look at Your heavens, the moon and the stars, I marvel that You care for us.
Thank You for making us a little lower than the angels and crowning us with glory and honor.

19.9.text: I give thanks to You, Lord, with all my heart. I will tell of all Your wonders.
You are a refuge for the oppressed, Lord, and a stronghold for me in times of trouble.
Help me know Your name and trust in You, for You do not forsake those who seek You.

19.10.text: Lord, do not stand far off or hide Yourself from me in times of trouble.
Arise, Lord! Lift up Your hand, God. Do not forget the helpless, and do not forget me.
Thank You that You see trouble and grief. I entrust myself to You, helper of the fatherless.

19.11.text: In You, Lord, I take refuge. Keep me steady when others tell me to flee.
Thank You that You are on Your heavenly throne and Your eyes are watching closely.
You are righteous, Lord, and You love justice. Make me upright, that I may see Your face.

19.12.text: Help, Lord, for it seems the godly are no more. Keep me faithful to You.
Your words, Lord, are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace. Help me trust them.
Thank You, Lord, that You will keep us and guard us forever.

19.13.text: How long, Lord? Do not forget me, and do not hide Your face from me.
I trust in Your loving devotion, Lord. Let my heart rejoice in Your salvation.
I will sing to You, Lord, for You have been good to me.

19.14.text: Lord, You look down from heaven to see who understands and who seeks You. Let me seek You.
I confess I have turned away like everyone else, Lord. Forgive me and bring me back.
Lord, You are a shelter for the oppressed. Be my shelter today.

19.15.text: Help me walk with integrity, practice righteousness and speak the truth from my heart.
Keep slander off my tongue, and keep me from harming my neighbor or scorning my friend.
Help me lend without interest and refuse a bribe against the innocent.

19.16.text: Lord, I say to You: You are my Lord, and apart from You I have no good thing.
Help me keep You always before me, Lord, because You are at my right hand.
Thank You for making known to me the path of life. Fill me with joy in Your presence.

19.17.text: I call on You, God, for You will answer me. Turn Your ear to me and hear my words.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye, and hide me in the shadow of Your wings.
Let me behold Your face in righteousness, and when I awake, satisfy me with Your presence.

19.18.text: Lord, You are my rock, my fortress and my deliverer. My God, I take refuge in You.
In my distress I call on You, Lord, and I cry to You for help. Thank You for hearing.
Light my lamp, Lord my God, and light up my darkness.

19.19.text: Your law is perfect, Lord. Let it revive my soul and make me wise.
Lord, who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart please You, my rock and redeemer.

19.20.text: Answer us in the day of trouble, Lord, and let Your name protect us.
Lord, I know You save Your anointed and answer from Your holy heaven with saving power.
Help us trust, not in chariots or horses, but in Your name, Lord our God.

19.21.text: Let me rejoice in Your strength, Lord, and exult greatly in Your salvation.
I trust in You, Lord. Through the loving devotion of the Most High, let me not be shaken.
Be exalted in Your strength, Lord. We will sing and praise Your power.

19.22.text: My God, my God, when I feel forsaken, do not be far from saving me.
Lord, do not be far off. You are my strength, so come quickly to help me.
Thank You that You have not despised the torment of the afflicted, but attended to their cry.

19.23.text: Lord, You are my shepherd. Teach me to rest in this: I shall not want.
In the valley of the shadow of death, let me fear no evil, for You are with me.
Thank You that goodness and mercy will follow me all my days, and I will dwell in Your house forever.

19.24.text: Thank You, Lord, that the earth is Yours, and the world and all who live in it.
Give me clean hands and a pure heart, and keep me from lifting my soul to an idol.
Make me one of those who seek You, who seek Your face, God.

19.25.text: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation.
Do not remember the sins of my youth or my rebellious acts. Remember me in Your loving devotion.
Guard my soul and deliver me, Lord, for I take refuge in You.

19.26.text: I ask You to test me and try me, Lord, and to examine my heart and mind.
Keep Your loving devotion before my eyes, Lord, and help me walk in Your truth.
Keep my feet on level ground, and let me bless You, Lord, in the congregations.

19.27.text: Lord, You are my light and my salvation, and the stronghold of my life. Whom shall I fear?
One thing I ask, Lord: to dwell in Your house all my days and gaze on Your beauty.
Help me wait patiently for You, Lord, and be strong and courageous.

19.28.text: Hear my cry for mercy, Lord, when I call to You for help and lift up my hands.
You are my strength and my shield, Lord. My heart trusts You, and I give thanks with my song.
Save Your people and bless Your inheritance, Lord. Shepherd us and carry us forever.

19.29.text: I give You the glory due Your name, Lord, and worship You in the splendor of Your holiness.
I praise You, Lord: Your voice is powerful and majestic.
Give Your people strength, Lord, and bless us with peace.

19.30.text: Lord my God, I cry to You for help. Heal me.
When weeping stays the night, remind me that Your favor lasts a lifetime and joy comes in the morning.
Turn my mourning into dancing, Lord, and clothe me with joy.

19.31.text: Into Your hands I commit my spirit, Lord, God of truth, for You have redeemed me.
I trust in You, Lord. I say, You are my God.
How great is Your goodness, laid up for those who fear You! Let me take refuge in You.

19.32.text: Forgive my transgressions and cover my sins, Lord, for blessed is the one who is forgiven.
I acknowledge my sin to You and do not hide my iniquity. Forgive the guilt of my sin.
You are my hiding place, Lord. Protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

19.33.text: Your word is upright, Lord, and all Your work is trustworthy. Help me rely on both.
Thank You that Your eyes are on those who fear You and hope in Your loving devotion.
Let Your loving devotion rest on us, Lord, for we put our hope in You.

19.34.text: I bless You, Lord, at all times. Let Your praise always be on my lips.
I seek You, Lord. Answer me and deliver me from all my fears.
Help me taste and see that You are good, Lord, and take refuge in You.

19.35.text: Let my soul rejoice in You, Lord, and exult in Your salvation.
Who is like You, Lord, who delivers the afflicted, the poor and the needy? I praise You.
Let my tongue proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.

19.36.text: Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, Lord, and Your faithfulness to the clouds. I thank You.
How precious is Your loving devotion, God! I take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
With You is the fountain of life. In Your light, Lord, let me see light.

19.37.text: Help me trust You and do good, and cultivate faithfulness in the land where I live.
Help me be still before You and wait patiently, and not fret when others prosper in their ways.
When I fall, hold my hand, Lord, so that I am not overwhelmed.

19.38.text: Lord, every desire of mine is before You, and my groaning is not hidden from You.
I confess my iniquity, Lord. I am troubled by my sin.
Do not forsake me, Lord, and do not be far from me. Come quickly to help me, my Savior.

19.39.text: Lord, help me know how fleeting my life is, and show me the measure of my days.
And now, Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
Hear my prayer, Lord, and do not be deaf to my weeping.

19.40.text: Lift me out of the pit of despair, set my feet on a rock and steady my steps.
Teach me to delight in doing Your will, my God, with Your law within my heart.
I am poor and needy, Lord. Think of me. You are my helper and deliverer, so do not delay.

19.41.text: Make me one who cares for the poor, and deliver me in the day of trouble.
Be gracious to me, Lord, and heal me. I confess I have sinned against You.
Uphold me in my integrity, Lord, and set me in Your presence forever.

19.42.text: My soul longs for You, God, like a deer that pants for streams of water.
When my soul is downcast, I will put my hope in You, God, for I will yet praise You.
Lord, You decree Your loving devotion by day. At night let Your song be with me as a prayer.

19.43.text: Send out Your light and Your truth, God, and let them lead me to where You dwell.
God, You are my greatest joy. I will go to Your altar and praise You.
Why am I downcast? I put my hope in You, my Savior and my God.

19.44.text: Thank You, God, for the works our fathers told us You did in their days.
In You, God, we boast all day long, and we will praise Your name forever.
Rise up and be our help, Lord. Redeem us because of Your loving devotion.

19.45.text: Lord, give victory to truth, humility and justice in our day.
I praise You, God: Your throne endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
Teach me to love righteousness and hate wickedness, as You do.

19.46.text: Thank You, God, that You are our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
Help us not to fear, though the earth is shaken and the mountains fall into the seas.
Help me be still and know that You are God, exalted among the nations and over the earth.

19.47.text: Let all peoples clap their hands and shout to You, God, with a voice of triumph. I join them.
I sing praises to You, God. I sing praises again and again.
You reign over the nations, God, and sit on Your holy throne. I bow before You.

19.48.text: Great are You, Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God.
Help us to contemplate Your loving devotion, God, within Your temple.
Thank You that You are our God forever and ever, and will be our guide even till death.

19.49.text: Let my mouth impart wisdom, and let the meditation of my heart bring understanding.
Thank You, God, that You will redeem my life from the grave and take me to Yourself.
Keep me from fear when others grow rich and the splendor of their houses increases.

19.50.text: Thank You that every beast of the forest is Yours, and the cattle on a thousand hills.
I call on You in the day of trouble. Deliver me, and I will honor You.
Help me honor You with thanksgiving and order my way rightly, and show me Your salvation.

19.51.text: Wash me clean from the wrong I have done, and cleanse me from my sin.
Give me back the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
I bring You a broken and humble heart, God, and You will not despise it.

19.52.text: Thank You, God, that Your loving devotion endures all day long.
Keep me like an olive tree flourishing in Your house, trusting in Your loving devotion forever and ever.
I will praise You forever for what You have done. I will wait on Your name, for it is good.

19.53.text: You look down from heaven to see who seeks You, God. Let me be one who seeks You.
All have turned away, and I too have turned away. I confess it to You, Lord.
When You restore Your captive people, God, let them rejoice and be glad.

19.54.text: Hear my prayer today, God, and listen to the words of my mouth.
You are my helper, God. You are the one who sustains my soul.
I will freely bring You my thanks and praise Your name, Lord, for it is good.

19.55.text: I call to You, God, and I trust You to save me.
Morning, noon and night I cry out to You in distress, and You hear my voice.
I cast my burden on You, Lord. Sustain me, for You never let the righteous be shaken.

19.56.text: I praise Your word, God, and I trust You. I will not be afraid.
You have counted my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle, Lord, for You keep them in Your book.
Thank You for keeping my feet from stumbling. Let me walk before You in the light of life.

19.57.text: Have mercy on me, God. I take shelter in the shadow of Your wings until the danger passes.
Keep my heart steadfast, God, and I will sing and make music to You.
Thank You, Lord, that Your loving devotion reaches the heavens and Your faithfulness the clouds.

19.58.text: Help me to speak justly and judge uprightly. Teach those who rule to do the same.
Thank You that the righteous have a reward, and that You are a God who judges the earth.

19.59.text: Lord, I keep watch for You, my strength. You, God, are my fortress.
My God of loving devotion, come to meet me today.
In the morning I will sing of Your strength. You are my refuge in times of trouble.

19.60.text: We are broken, God. Restore us.
Heal what is broken in our land, Lord, for it is shaking.
Be with us, God, and we will act with courage.

19.61.text: Whenever my heart is faint, lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Let me dwell with You forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings.
I will sing praise to Your name always and keep my promises to You day by day.

19.62.text: My soul finds rest in You alone, God. My salvation comes from You.
Help us trust You at all times and pour out our hearts before You, for You are our refuge.
If my riches increase, Lord, do not let me set my heart on them.

19.63.text: God, You are my God. I seek You earnestly, and my soul thirsts for You.
Your loving devotion is better than life, so my lips will glorify You.
My soul clings to You, Lord. Hold me up with Your right hand.

19.64.text: Hear my complaint, God, and preserve my life from dread.
Hide me, Lord, from the schemes of the wicked.
Let me rejoice in You, Lord, and take refuge in You, with all the upright in heart.

19.65.text: You listen to prayer, Lord. I come to You now.
When my sins weigh on me, thank You that You atone for our wrongs.
Thank You for watering the earth and preparing our grain.

19.66.text: Let me sing the glory of Your name and make my praise glorious.
Thank You for preserving our lives and keeping our feet from slipping.
Thank You, God, for hearing me and attending to the sound of my prayer.

19.67.text: Be gracious to us, God, and bless us. Make Your face shine upon us.
Let Your ways be known on earth and Your salvation among all nations.
Thank You for the harvest the earth has yielded. You, our God, bless us.

19.68.text: Thank You, God, that You are a father to the fatherless and a defender of widows.
God, You settle the lonely in families. Do this for those who are alone today.
Lord, You bear our burden daily. Thank You, God of our salvation.

19.69.text: God, save me. The waters have risen to my neck.
Answer me, Lord, for Your loving devotion is good. Turn to me in Your great compassion.
I will praise Your name in song, God, and exalt You with thanksgiving.

19.70.text: God, hurry to deliver me. Lord, make haste to help me.
Let all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You, Lord.
I am poor and needy. You are my help and my deliverer, Lord, so do not delay.

19.71.text: I have taken refuge in You, Lord. Do not let me ever be put to shame.
I will always hope in You, and I will praise You more and more.
When I am old and gray, do not forsake me, God, until I tell the next generation of Your power.

19.72.text: Give those who lead us Your justice, God, and Your righteousness.
Let those who lead us deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
Blessed are You, Lord God. You alone do marvelous deeds.

19.73.text: Thank You that I am always with You and that You hold my right hand.
When my flesh and my heart fail, be the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
It is good to draw near to You, God. I make You my refuge.

19.74.text: Thank You, God, for working salvation on the earth since ancient times.
The day is Yours, and the night also. Thank You for setting the moon and the sun.
Do not let the oppressed turn back in shame. Let the poor and needy praise Your name.

19.75.text: We give thanks to You, God, for Your name is near. We declare Your wondrous works.
Thank You, God, that You judge fairly in the time You choose.
I will proclaim You forever and sing praise to You, my God.

19.76.text: Lord, You shine with light, more majestic than the mountains.
Thank You that You rose up to save all the lowly of the earth.
Help me keep every promise I have made to You, Lord my God.

19.77.text: I cry aloud to You, God. Please hear me.
Let me reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
Thank You, God, that You work wonders and show Your strength among the peoples.

19.78.text: Help us tell the next generation Your praises, Your might and the wonders You have done.
Teach us to put our confidence in You, not forgetting Your works, and to keep Your commands.
Help me always to remember that You, God Most High, are my rock and my redeemer.

19.79.text: Lord, do not hold our past sins against us. Let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name. Deliver us and atone for our sins.
We are Your people, the sheep of Your pasture. We will thank You forever and declare Your praise.

19.80.text: Hear us, You who lead Your people like a flock, and shine forth.
Restore us, God. Make Your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.
Revive us, Lord, and we will not turn away from You but call on Your name.

19.81.text: God our strength, I sing for joy to You and make a joyful noise.
Lord my God, I open my mouth wide before You. Please fill it.
Help me listen to You and follow Your ways, Lord.

19.82.text: Teach me to defend the weak and the fatherless and to uphold the rights of the afflicted.
Show me how to rescue the weak and needy from the hand of the wicked.
Rise up, God, and judge the earth, for all the nations are Yours.

19.83.text: God, do not be silent. Do not stay speechless or still.
Let all the earth know that You alone, whose name is the Lord, are Most High.

19.84.text: My soul longs for Your courts, Lord. My heart cries out for the living God.
One day in Your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in Your house.
Lord, how blessed is the one who trusts in You. I put my trust in You.

19.85.text: Revive us again, Lord, so that Your people may rejoice in You.
I will listen to what You say, Lord, for You speak peace to Your people.
Provide what is good for us, Lord, and let our land yield its increase.

19.86.text: Thank You that You are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
When I am in distress, Lord, I call on You, because You answer me.
Teach me Your way, Lord, so that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart.

19.87.text: Thank You, Lord, that You have founded Your city on the holy mountains.
Lord, let all my springs of joy be found in You.

19.88.text: Lord, God of my salvation, I cry out before You day and night.
My eyes grow dim with grief. Lord, I call to You every day and spread out my hands to You.
But to You, Lord, I cry for help. Each morning my prayer comes before You.

19.89.text: I will sing of Your loving devotion forever, and proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
Thank You, Lord, that You rule the raging sea and still its waves.
Let me know the joyful sound and walk in the light of Your presence, Lord.

19.90.text: Thank You, Lord, that You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
Teach me to number my days, so that I may bring You a heart of wisdom.
Satisfy us each morning with Your loving devotion, so that we may sing for joy and be glad.

19.91.text: Thank You that under Your wings I find refuge, and that Your faithfulness is my shield.
Lord, please command Your angels to guard me in all my ways.
I call out to You, Lord. Answer me and be with me in trouble.

19.92.text: Let me proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night.
You have made me glad by Your deeds, Lord. I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
Your works are great, Lord, and Your thoughts are deep. I praise You.

19.93.text: Thank You, Lord, that You reign. You are robed in majesty and clothed with strength.
Your throne was set long ago, Lord, and You are from all eternity.
Above the roar of the mighty waters, You on high are majestic, Lord.

19.94.text: When my foot slips, Lord, let Your loving devotion hold me up.
When anxiety overwhelms me, let Your comfort delight my soul.
Thank You, Lord, that You have been my stronghold and my rock of refuge.

19.95.text: Let us sing for joy to You, Lord, and shout to the rock of our salvation.
Let us worship and bow down, and kneel before You, our maker.
Today, if I hear Your voice, keep me from hardening my heart.

19.96.text: I bless Your name, Lord, and proclaim Your salvation day after day.
Help us declare Your glory among the nations and Your wonders among all peoples.
I worship You, Lord, in the splendor of Your holiness.

19.97.text: Lord, You reign, so let the earth rejoice and the distant shores be glad.
Teach me to hate evil, as one who loves You, and preserve my soul.
Thank You that light shines on the righteous and gladness on the upright in heart.

19.98.text: I sing a new song to You, Lord, for You have done wonders.
Thank You, Lord, that the ends of the earth have seen Your salvation.
Thank You that You will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.

19.99.text: Let us praise Your great and awesome name, Lord. You are holy.
Thank You, Lord, that You love justice and have established equity.
You answered those who called on Your name. I call on You now, Lord.

19.100.text: Help me serve You with gladness and come into Your presence with joyful songs.
I know that You, Lord, are God. You made us, and we are Your people, the sheep of Your pasture.
You are good, Lord. Your loving devotion endures forever, and Your faithfulness continues to all generations.

19.101.text: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice, Lord. To You I will sing praises.
Help me to walk in my own house with integrity of heart.
Help me set no worthless thing before my eyes.

19.102.text: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear and answer me quickly.
Lord, You are enthroned forever, and Your renown lasts to all generations. I put my trust in You.
Thank You that You turn toward the prayer of the destitute and do not despise their prayer.

19.103.text: You are compassionate and gracious, Lord, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion. Thank You.
Thank You, Lord, that You have not dealt with me as my sins deserve.
Thank You that You have removed my sins from me as far as the east is from the west.

19.104.text: How many are Your works, Lord! You made them all in wisdom, and Your creatures fill the earth.
Thank You, Lord, that when You open Your hand, Your creatures are satisfied with good things.
May my thoughts of You please You, Lord, for I rejoice in You.

19.105.text: I give thanks to You, Lord, and call on Your name. Help me to make Your deeds known.
I seek You and Your strength, Lord. Help me to seek Your face always.
Thank You, Lord, that You remember Your covenant forever, for a thousand generations.

19.106.text: Remember me, Lord, when You show favor to Your people, and visit me with Your salvation.
Lord, we have sinned, as our fathers did. We have done wrong and acted wickedly.
Thank You that You hear our cry and take note of our distress, Lord.

19.107.text: When I am in trouble I cry out to You, Lord. Deliver me from my distress.
You satisfy the thirsty and fill the hungry with good things. Satisfy and fill me, Lord.
Make me wise to pay attention to these things and to consider Your loving devotion, Lord.

19.108.text: Keep my heart steady, God, and I will sing and make music to You with all my being.
Your loving devotion reaches higher than the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds. Thank You, God.
Answer and save us with Your right hand, God, so that those You love may be delivered.

19.109.text: I am poor and needy, Lord, and my heart is wounded within me.
Help me, Lord my God, and save me according to Your loving devotion.
Thank You that You stand at the right hand of the needy to save them.

19.110.text: Father, You told my Lord to sit at Your right hand. Help me honor Him.
Lord, You have sworn and will not change Your mind. I rest in what You have sworn.

19.111.text: I give thanks to You, Lord, with all my heart, in the company of the upright.
You provide food for those who fear You, Lord. Thank You for remembering Your covenant forever.
Teach me to fear You, Lord, for that is the beginning of wisdom.

19.112.text: Teach me to fear You, Lord, and to delight greatly in Your commands.
Thank You that light dawns in the darkness for the upright. Make me gracious, compassionate and righteous.
Let me not fear bad news. Make my heart steady, trusting in You, Lord.

19.113.text: From sunrise to sunset Your name is praised, Lord. I praise You today.
Who is like You, Lord our God? You humble Yourself to behold the heavens and the earth.
Thank You that You raise the poor from the dust and lift the needy from the dump.

19.114.text: Let the whole earth tremble before You, Lord, and let me stand in awe of Your presence.
Thank You, Lord, that You turned rock into a pool and flint into a fountain of water.

19.115.text: Let the glory be Yours, Lord, and not mine, because of Your loving devotion and faithfulness.
I trust in You, Lord. You are my help and my shield.
We will bless You, Lord, both now and forevermore.

19.116.text: Because You bend Your ear to me, Lord, I will call on You as long as I live.
Thank You for delivering my soul from death, my eyes from tears and my feet from stumbling.
What can I give back to You, Lord, for all Your goodness to me?

19.117.text: Let every nation praise You, Lord, and let all peoples extol You.
Great is Your loving devotion toward us, Lord, and Your faithfulness endures forever.

19.118.text: You are on my side, Lord, so I will not be afraid.
You are my strength and my song, Lord. You have become my salvation.
This is the day You have made, Lord. Help me to rejoice and be glad in it.

19.119.text: I hide Your word in my heart, Lord, so that I might not sin against You.
In my trouble Your promise is my comfort. Thank You that it has given me life.
I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek me, Lord, for I have not forgotten Your commands.

19.120.text: In my distress I cried to You, Lord, and You answered me. Thank You.
Save me, Lord, from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue.
Make me a person of peace, Lord, even when others want war.

19.121.text: My help comes from You, Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.
Do not let my foot slip, Lord. Thank You that You never slumber.
Lord, be my keeper and the shade at my right hand.

19.122.text: Lord, make me glad whenever it is time to go to Your house.
Lord, for the sake of my brothers and friends, I pray for peace.

19.123.text: I lift up my eyes to You, Lord, who sit enthroned in heaven.
Our eyes are on You, Lord, as servants watch their master's hand, until You show us mercy.
Have mercy on us, Lord, for we have endured much contempt.

19.124.text: Blessed are You, Lord, for You have not given us up as prey.
Thank You that we escaped like a bird from the snare. The net is torn and we have slipped away.
Our help is in Your name, Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.

19.125.text: Make me one who trusts in You, Lord, firm like a mountain that cannot be moved.
Thank You, Lord, that You surround Your people as mountains surround a city, now and forevermore.
Do good, Lord, to the upright in heart, and make my heart upright.

19.126.text: You have done great things for us, Lord, and we are filled with joy.
Restore us, Lord, like streams in a dry land.
When I sow in tears, Lord, let me reap with shouts of joy.

19.127.text: Unless You build the house, Lord, its builders labor in vain. Build my home and my work.
I rise early and stay up late. Teach me to rest, for You give sleep to Your beloved.

19.128.text: Thank You that those who fear You and walk in Your ways are blessed. Teach me to do both.
Bless the work of my hands, Lord, so that I may eat the fruit of my labor.
Bless us, Lord, all the days of our lives, and let us see the generations that come after us.

19.129.text: Thank You, Lord, that though I have been persecuted since my youth, I have not been overcome.
You are righteous, Lord. Thank You for cutting me free from the cords of the wicked.

19.130.text: Out of the depths I cry to You, Lord. Hear my voice and listen to my plea for mercy.
If You kept a record of sins, no one could stand. Thank You that with You there is forgiveness.
I wait for You, Lord. My soul waits, and in Your word I put my hope.

19.131.text: Keep my heart humble and my eyes from pride, Lord. Keep me from things too lofty for me.
Still and quiet my soul, Lord, like a weaned child with its mother.
Teach me to put my hope in You, Lord, now and forevermore.

19.132.text: Let us go to Your dwelling place, Lord, and worship at Your footstool.
Clothe those who serve You with righteousness, Lord, and let Your saints shout for joy.
Lord, satisfy the poor among Your people with bread.

19.133.text: Help us to live together in harmony, Lord, for it is good and pleasant.
Let Your blessing of life fall on us, Lord, like dew on the mountains.

19.134.text: I bless You, Lord, with all who serve You in Your house, even by night.
I lift up my hands to You and bless Your name, Lord.
Lord, maker of heaven and earth, bless us.

19.135.text: You are good, Lord, and Your name is lovely. I sing praises to You.
You do all that pleases You in heaven, on earth and in the seas. I trust You, Lord.
Thank You that You will stand up for Your people and have compassion on Your servants.

19.136.text: Thank You, Lord, for You are good. Your loving devotion never ends.
Thank You for remembering us when we were brought low. Your loving devotion endures forever.
Thank You for giving food to every living creature, Lord.

19.137.text: Lord, there are days I sit and weep when I remember home. Hear my sorrow.
In a land that is not mine, help me still to sing a song of the Lord.

19.138.text: Thank You that on the day I called, You answered me and strengthened my soul.
Thank You that though You are on high, You attend to the lowly.
Fulfill Your purpose for me, Lord, and do not abandon the work of Your hands.

19.139.text: Thank You that even in the farthest place Your hand will guide me and Your right hand will hold me.
I praise You, Lord, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are marvelous.
Show me any way in me that offends You, Lord, and lead me in the way everlasting.

19.140.text: Rescue me, Lord, from evil, and protect me from violence.
You are the strength of my salvation, Lord, and You shield my head in the day of battle.
Thank You, Lord, that You uphold justice for the poor and defend the cause of the needy.

19.141.text: Let my prayer be set before You like incense, Lord, and my lifted hands like the evening offering.
Set a guard over my mouth, Lord, and keep watch at the door of my lips.
My eyes are fixed on You, Lord. In You I take refuge, so do not leave me defenseless.

19.142.text: I pour out my complaint before You, Lord, and tell You all my trouble.
My spirit grows faint within me, but You know my way, Lord.
You are my refuge, Lord, my portion in the land of the living.

19.143.text: Do not bring me into judgment, Lord, for no one alive is righteous before You.
I stretch out my hands to You, and my soul thirsts for You like dry ground.
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I trust You. Teach me the way to walk.

19.144.text: You are my fortress, my stronghold, my deliverer and my shield, Lord. In You I take refuge.
Lord, what is man, that You regard him? Yet You think of me. Thank You.
Thank You that the people whose God is the Lord are blessed. You are my God.

19.145.text: Every day I will bless You, Lord, and praise Your name forever and ever.
Thank You, Lord, that You uphold all who fall and lift up all who are bowed down.
You are near to all who call on You, Lord. I call on You in truth.

19.146.text: I will praise You all my life, Lord, and sing to You while I have my being.
You are my help and my hope, Lord my God. Blessed is the one who trusts in You.
Lord, You lift up those who are weighed down. I bring You my burdens.

19.147.text: You heal the brokenhearted and bind up their wounds, Lord. Heal my heart.
Great are You, Lord, and mighty in power. Your understanding has no limit, so I trust You.
You are pleased with those who fear You and hope in Your loving devotion, Lord. Let me be one.

19.148.text: Let all You have made praise Your name, Lord, for You commanded and they were created.
Let young and old praise You together, Lord, and let me join them.
Your name alone is exalted, Lord. Your splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

19.149.text: Lord, I join Your people to sing You a new song of praise.
Let us praise Your name with dancing, and make music to You with tambourine and harp.
Thank You, Lord, that You take pleasure in Your people and adorn the afflicted with salvation.

19.150.text: I praise You, God, for Your mighty acts and for Your excellent greatness.
Let me praise You with tambourine and dancing, with strings and flute.
Let everything that has breath praise You, Lord, and let me be one of them.

20.1.text: Teach me to fear You, Lord, for that is where knowledge begins.
Help me listen to my father's instruction and not forsake my mother's teaching.
When others try to entice me into sin, help me not to give in to them.

20.2.text: Teach me to seek wisdom like silver and search for it like hidden treasure.
Lord, You give wisdom. Let knowledge and understanding come to me from Your mouth.
You are a shield to those who walk with integrity. Help me walk that way.

20.3.text: Help me trust You with all my heart and not lean on my own understanding.
Help me acknowledge You in all my ways, and make my paths straight.
Help me not to hold back good from those who deserve it when I am able to give.

20.4.text: Help me prize wisdom above all, and gain understanding in everything I acquire.
Help me guard my heart with great care, because my life flows from it.
Take deception out of my mouth, and keep my lips from crooked speech.

20.5.text: Help me keep discretion, and let my lips preserve knowledge.
Help me listen to my teachers and mentors, and not turn my ear away.
Lord, all my ways are before Your eyes. Help me walk as one who knows You see.

20.6.text: Teach me to watch the ways of the ant and become wise.
Keep haughty eyes and a lying tongue far from me.
Make Your teaching a lamp and a light for me, and correction a way to life.

20.7.text: Help me keep Your words and treasure Your commands deep within me.
Write Your words on my heart and keep them close at hand.
Keep my heart from turning aside to tempting ways, and keep me from straying into them.

20.8.text: Help me value instruction above silver and knowledge above fine gold.
Teach me to fear You, which means to hate evil, arrogant pride and perverse speech.
Help me listen to instruction and become wise, and never ignore it.

20.9.text: Help me leave foolishness behind and walk in the way of understanding.
Keep me teachable, so that I grow wiser every time I am instructed.
Teach me to know the Holy One, for that is where understanding comes from.

20.10.text: Make my hands diligent in my work, and keep me from idleness.
Fill me with love that covers wrongs, and keep hatred from stirring up trouble through me.
Help me restrain my lips and not talk so much that I end up sinning.

20.11.text: Help me be honest in buying and selling, because honest weights please You.
Make me trustworthy, a person who keeps a confidence and does not gossip.
Let me be a generous person who refreshes others.

20.12.text: Teach me to love discipline and not to hate correction.
Keep me from rash words that pierce, and give me a tongue that brings healing.
When anxiety weighs on my heart, cheer me with a good word, and help me give one.

20.13.text: Help me guard my mouth and think before I open my lips.
When my hope is delayed and my heart grows sick, Lord, comfort me.
Lead me to walk with wise people, so that I become wise.

20.14.text: Keep me from any way that seems right to me but ends in death.
Keep me from despising anyone, and help me show kindness to the poor.
Make me patient, and keep my temper from leading me into foolishness.

20.15.text: Give me a gentle answer when anger rises, so that wrath is turned away.
Help me value a little with the fear of You above great treasure with turmoil.
Help me seek counsel before I make plans, and listen to those who advise me.

20.16.text: I commit my work to You, Lord, and I trust my plans to You.
I make my plans, Lord, but You direct my steps. Guide me.
Make me slow to anger and able to control my temper.

20.17.text: Help me cover an offense with love and not bring it up to separate friends.
Make me a friend who loves at all times, especially in hard days.
Give me a joyful heart, and lift me when my spirit is broken.

20.18.text: Your name is a strong tower, Lord. I run to You for safety.
Help me listen to the whole matter before I answer.
Lord, my tongue has the power of life and death. Help me use it to give life.

20.19.text: Give me knowledge to go with my zeal, and keep me from rushing and missing the mark.
Give me insight and patience, and help me overlook an offense.
Help me be kind to the poor, for kindness to them is a loan to You.

20.20.text: Help me to be a person who walks with integrity.
I cannot say I have kept my heart pure. Cleanse me from my sin, Lord.
When I am wronged, keep me from taking revenge. Help me wait on You, Lord, to save me.

20.21.text: Help me do what is right and just, which You desire more than sacrifice.
Keep me from shutting my ears to the cry of the poor.
Help me pursue righteousness and loving devotion all my days.

20.22.text: Help me value a good name above great riches.
Lord, You made both the rich and the poor. Help me never to look down on anyone.
Make me ready to share my bread with the poor.

20.23.text: Keep me from wearing myself out to get rich, and give me wisdom to restrain myself.
Keep my heart from envying those who sin, and keep me in the fear of You always.
Help me hold on to truth, wisdom, instruction and understanding, and never sell them.

20.24.text: Lord, build my household by wisdom and establish it by understanding.
Give me courage to rescue those who are being led away to death.
Even if I fall seven times, lift me up and help me to rise again.

20.25.text: Help me speak words that fit the moment, like apples of gold in settings of silver.
Give me the patience that can persuade a ruler, and a gentle tongue.
Help me control my temper, so that I am not like a city with broken walls.

20.26.text: Keep me from being wise in my own eyes, and keep me ready to be taught.
Keep me from deceiving anyone and then saying I was only joking.
Help me not to feed gossip, so that conflict may cease.

20.27.text: Keep me from boasting about tomorrow, for I do not know what a day may bring.
As iron sharpens iron, use me to sharpen others, and let others sharpen me.
Help me know the state of all You have put in my care, and watch over it closely.

20.28.text: Keep me from hiding my sins. I confess them and turn from them; have mercy on me.
Keep me from trusting in myself, and help me walk in wisdom.
Help me give to the poor and never hide my eyes from their need.

20.29.text: Help me hold back my anger instead of pouring it all out.
Give us vision, Lord, so that we do not cast off restraint, and help us keep Your law.
Free me from the fear of people, and help me trust in You, Lord.

20.30.text: Every word of Yours is flawless. Thank You for being a shield to all who take refuge in You.
Keep lies far from me. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the bread I need.
Let me not have so much that I deny You, nor so little that I steal and dishonor Your name.

20.31.text: Help me to open my mouth for those who have no voice.
Let me speak with wisdom, and let faithful instruction be on my tongue.
Teach me to fear You rather than trust in charm or beauty, which do not last.

40.1.text: Thank You that Jesus came to save His people from their sins.
Thank You that in Jesus, God is with us.

40.2.text: I come to worship You, Jesus, the One who was born a king.
Lead me to Jesus, and let me rejoice with great delight when I find Him.
I bow before You, Jesus, and offer You my treasures as a gift.

40.3.text: Turn my heart to repent, Lord, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
Help me produce fruit in keeping with repentance.
Thank You, Father, that Jesus is Your beloved Son, and You are pleased with Him.

40.4.text: Teach me to live on every word that comes from Your mouth, not on bread alone.
Help me worship You, Lord my God, and serve You only.
Help me follow You at once, as the fishermen left their nets and followed You.

40.5.text: Make me poor in spirit, Lord, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
Make my heart pure, Lord, for the pure in heart will see God.
Let my light shine before others, so they see my good deeds and glorify You, Father.

40.6.text: Father, You are unseen and You see what is done in secret. Teach me to pray to You in secret.
Help me seek first Your kingdom and Your righteousness, trusting You to add what I need.
Keep me from worrying about tomorrow. Today has enough trouble of its own.

40.7.text: Thank You, Father, that You give good things to those who ask You. I ask You now.
Help me do to others what I would have them do to me.
Help me hear Your words and act on them, like a wise man building on the rock.

40.8.text: Lord, I kneel before You. If You are willing, You can make me clean.
Lord, I am not worthy to have You under my roof. I trust that Your word is enough.
Lord, when I feel I am perishing in the storm, I cry to You. Save me.

40.9.text: Thank You, Jesus, that You have authority on earth to forgive sins. Forgive mine.
Thank You, Jesus, that You had compassion on the crowds who were harassed and helpless.
Lord of the harvest, I ask You to send out workers into Your harvest.

40.10.text: Freely I have received from You. Teach me to give freely, too.
Thank You, Father, that I am worth more than many sparrows. Keep me from fear.
Help me give even a cup of cold water to one of Your little ones.

40.11.text: I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, for revealing these things to little children.
Jesus, I am weary and burdened. I come to You for rest.
Teach me to take Your yoke and learn from You, for You are gentle and humble in heart.

40.12.text: Thank You that Jesus will not break a bruised reed or put out a smoldering wick.
Make my heart good, for out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
Father in heaven, help me do Your will, for Jesus calls those who do it His family.

40.13.text: Keep the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth from choking Your word in me.
Make my heart good soil. Help me hear Your word, understand it and bear fruit.
Make Your kingdom my treasure. Give me the joy of the man who found it.

40.14.text: Take what little I have, Jesus. Bless it, and let it feed others.
Jesus, when I am afraid, say to me again: take courage, it is I.
Lord, when I begin to sink, I cry out to You. Save me!

40.15.text: Keep my heart close to You, so that I honor You with more than my lips.
Lord, I come to You in my need. Help me.
Give me Your compassion for people who have nothing to eat.

40.16.text: Jesus, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God. I believe it.
Help me deny myself, take up my cross and follow You.
Keep me from gaining the whole world and forfeiting my soul.

40.17.text: Help me listen to Jesus, Your beloved Son, in whom You are well pleased.
When I fall down in fear, Jesus, touch me and say, do not be afraid.
Lord, I have so little faith. Give me faith, even as small as a mustard seed.

40.18.text: Change me, Lord, and make me humble like a little child.
Jesus, we gather in Your name. Thank You that You are with us.
Help me show mercy to others, just as You have shown mercy to me.

40.19.text: Help me never hinder children from coming to You, for the kingdom belongs to such as these.
Help me honor my father and mother, and love my neighbor as myself.
When a thing seems impossible to me, remind me that with You all things are possible.

40.20.text: Keep me from envy when You are generous to someone else.
Thank You, Jesus, that You came to serve and to give Your life as a ransom for many.
Lord, have mercy on me. I will keep crying out, even when others tell me to be quiet.

40.21.text: Hosanna to Jesus! Blessed is He who comes in the Lord's name.
Let Your house be a house of prayer, and let me come to pray there.
Thank You that You have ordained praise from the mouths of children and infants.

40.22.text: Help me give to God what belongs to God.
Teach me to love You, Lord my God, with all my heart, soul and mind.
Help me love my neighbor as myself.

40.23.text: Keep me from exalting myself. Help me humble myself before You.
Teach me the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy and faithfulness.
Jesus, You have longed to gather Your people as a hen gathers her chicks. Keep me willing.

40.24.text: Help me to persevere to the end, for the one who perseveres will be saved.
Thank You, Jesus, that Your words will never pass away.
Keep me watching and ready, for I do not know the day my Lord will come.

40.25.text: Make me faithful with the few things You have given me.
Help me to feed the hungry, give drink to the thirsty and take in the stranger.
Let me remember that what I do for the least of these, I do for You.

40.26.text: Thank You, Jesus, that Your blood was poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
Father, when I do not want Your way, help me pray: not as I will, but as You will.
Help me watch and pray, so that I do not enter into temptation. My body is weak.

40.27.text: Jesus, You cried out, asking why God had forsaken You. Keep me from ever taking Your cross lightly.
Lord, like the centurion at the cross, I say it: truly You are the Son of God.

40.28.text: Thank You that Jesus has risen, just as He said.
Help me go and make disciples, for You have all authority in heaven and on earth.
Thank You that You are with me always, even to the end of the age.

41.1.text: Help me to repent and believe the gospel, for the kingdom of God is near.
Teach me to pray as Jesus did, early in the morning in a quiet place.
Thank You, Jesus, that You were moved with compassion for the man who begged You.

41.2.text: Help me bring those in need to You, as four men carried the paralytic.
Thank You, Jesus, that You came to call sinners. I am one, and I come to You.
Teach me to receive the Sabbath as Your gift, made for people.

41.3.text: Keep my heart soft toward You, Jesus. Do not let it grow hard.
Jesus, You appointed the twelve to be with You and to preach. Keep me close to You.
Teach me to do the will of God, for Jesus calls those who do it His brothers and sisters.

41.4.text: Help me hear Your word, receive it, and bear fruit.
Help me pay attention to what I hear from You.
Jesus, You told the wind and the sea to be still. Calm the storm in my life.

41.5.text: Help me tell others how much the Lord has done for me, and what mercy He has shown me.
Like the woman who pushed through the crowd to touch Your cloak, I reach for You, Jesus.
When fear comes, Jesus, say to me: do not be afraid, just believe.

41.6.text: Jesus, call me to a quiet place with You, to rest for a while.
Jesus, You had compassion on people who were like sheep without a shepherd. Have compassion on me.
Remind me to bring You even what little I have, as Your disciples did with five loaves and two fish.

41.7.text: Cleanse my heart, Lord, for the evils that defile a person come from within.
Open my ears to hear You, Jesus, and loose my tongue to speak plainly.
Jesus, You have done all things well. I praise You.

41.8.text: Jesus, where I see only dimly, touch me again until I see clearly.
Teach me what it means to come after You, Jesus, to deny myself and take up my cross.
Keep me from being ashamed of You and Your words, Jesus.

41.9.text: Jesus, I believe. Help me where I still doubt.
Make me a servant of all, Lord, and not one who must be first.
Help us to have salt among ourselves, and to be at peace with one another.

41.10.text: Help me receive the kingdom of God like a little child.
Show me the one thing I lack, Jesus, and help me come and follow You.
Jesus, You ask what I want You to do for me. Let me answer You honestly.

41.11.text: Let Your house be a house of prayer for all the nations.
Help me to have faith in God, as Jesus told His disciples.
When I stand to pray, show me what I hold against anyone, and help me forgive.

41.12.text: Help me know the Bible and the power of God, so that I am not mistaken.
Help me love You, Lord my God, with all my heart, soul, mind and strength.
Teach me to give with a whole heart, as the poor widow did.

41.13.text: Let the gospel be proclaimed to every nation, Lord, and use my life to help.
When I must answer for You and do not know what to say, let the Holy Spirit speak through me.
Keep me on guard and alert, for I do not know when the appointed time will come.

41.14.text: Help me do what I can for You, Jesus, as the woman who anointed You did what she could.
Thank You, Jesus, that Your blood of the covenant was poured out for many.
Father, all things are possible for You. Help me say, not what I will, but what You will.

41.15.text: Jesus, You let out a loud cry and breathed Your last. I bow in silence before You.
Truly this man was the Son of God. Let that be what I see when I look at the cross.
Make me one who waits for the kingdom of God, and give me boldness for Jesus.

41.16.text: Thank You, Lord, that the tomb is empty and Jesus has risen.
Forgive my unbelief and hardness of heart, Jesus, and help me believe.
Help me preach the gospel to everyone, as Jesus told His disciples.

42.1.text: Thank You that no word from You will ever fail. Help me trust what You have said.
I am Your servant, Lord. May it happen to me according to Your word.
Help me serve You without fear, in holiness and righteousness, all the days of my life.

42.2.text: Thank You for the Savior who was born for us, Christ the Lord.
Help me treasure what You do and ponder it in my heart.
Help me grow in wisdom, and in favor with God and with people.

42.3.text: Let my life produce fruit in keeping with repentance.
Help me share what I have with the one who has none, my clothes and my food.
Father, thank You that Jesus is Your beloved Son, and that You are well pleased with Him.

42.4.text: Let me worship You, Lord my God, and give my service to You only.
Thank You that You sent Jesus to preach good news to the poor and to release the oppressed.
Jesus, I bring to You those who are ill. You laid Your hands on each one and healed them.

42.5.text: Lord, when I have worked hard and caught nothing, help me obey because You say so.
Teach me to slip away to quiet places and pray, as Jesus often did.
Thank You, Jesus, for calling sinners like me to repentance.

42.6.text: Teach me to do good to those who hate me, and to pray for those who mistreat me.
Father, You are merciful. Make me merciful, just as You are.
Lord, keep me from calling You Lord and not doing what You say.

42.7.text: Lord, I am not worthy, but just say the word and heal the one I pray for.
Lord, have compassion on those who weep, as You had compassion on the widow.
Forgive my many sins, Lord, and let me love You much.

42.8.text: Give me a noble and good heart that hears Your word, clings to it and perseveres.
Help me tell those at home how much You have done for me.
Do not let me be afraid, Lord. Help me just believe.

42.9.text: Help me deny myself, take up my cross daily and follow You.
Father, help me listen to Your Son, whom You have chosen.
Keep me from seeking to be the greatest. Help me welcome little children in Your name.

42.10.text: Lord of the harvest, send out workers into Your harvest, for the workers are few.
Help me love You with all my heart, soul, strength and mind, and love my neighbor as myself.
Help me choose the good portion, to sit at Your feet and listen to Your message.

42.11.text: Lord, teach us to pray, as Your disciples asked You.
Father in heaven, I ask You for the Holy Spirit.
Make me one of those who hear the word of God and obey it.

42.12.text: Thank You that the very hairs of my head are numbered. Help me not to be afraid.
Guard me against every kind of greed, for life is more than having many possessions.
Help me seek Your kingdom, and trust that You will add what I need.

42.13.text: Let Your kingdom grow, Lord, like a mustard seed that becomes a tree.
Help me make every effort to enter through the narrow door.
Gather me under Your wings, as a hen gathers her chicks. Make me willing.

42.14.text: Keep me from exalting myself. Teach me to humble myself before You.
Help me welcome the poor and the lame, who cannot repay me.
Help me count the cost of following You, so that I can finish what I begin.

42.15.text: Thank You that there is joy in heaven over one sinner who repents.
Father, I will get up and come back to You. I have sinned against heaven and against You.
Father, I come to You. Meet me with compassion, as the father ran to his son.

42.16.text: Help me be faithful with very little, so that I am faithful with much.
Help me serve You, God, and not to serve money.
Lord, You know my heart. Keep me from trying to justify myself before people.

42.17.text: Help me forgive each time someone comes back and says they repent.
Lord, increase my faith, as Your apostles asked.
When You have helped me, let me come back to You with loud praise.

42.18.text: Teach me to pray at all times and not lose heart.
God, I come to You as the tax collector did. Have mercy on me, a sinner.
Thank You that what is impossible with people is possible with You.

42.19.text: Lord, if I have cheated anyone, help me repay it. Make me generous to the poor.
Thank You, Jesus, for coming to seek and to save the lost.
Let me praise You joyfully, in a loud voice, for all the miracles You have done.

42.20.text: Thank You, Father, that the stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
Teach me to give to God what is God's, and to the government what is its due.
Thank You that You are the God of the living, for to You all are alive.

42.21.text: Teach me to give as the poor widow did, not only from what I have to spare.
Thank You, Jesus, that Your words will never pass away, though heaven and earth will.
Keep my heart from being weighed down by drunkenness and the worries of life.

42.22.text: Jesus, thank You for giving Your body for me. Help me remember You.
Lord, keep my faith from failing, and help me strengthen others.
Father, when I ask You for things, let Your will be done, not mine.

42.23.text: Father, as Jesus asked You to forgive those who crucified Him, help me forgive those who wrong me.
Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom, as the criminal beside You asked.
Father, into Your hands I commit my spirit, as Jesus did.

42.24.text: Thank You, Father, that Jesus is not here among the dead. He has risen.
Stay with me, Lord, as evening comes and the day is almost over.
Open the Bible to me, Lord, and let my heart burn within me as I listen.

43.1.text: Jesus, I receive You and believe in Your name. Thank You for the right to be a child of God.
Thank You that the Word became flesh and lived among us, full of grace and truth.
Thank You, Jesus, that You take away the sin of the world.

43.2.text: Lord, help me do whatever You tell me.
Jesus, reveal Your glory to me, as You did at the wedding, and let me believe in You.
You know what is in every person, so I will not hide my heart from You.

43.3.text: Jesus, You said no one can see the kingdom of God unless born again. Give me new birth.
Thank You, God, that You loved the world and gave Your only Son. I believe in Him.
Lord, let Jesus increase in my life, and let me decrease.

43.4.text: Give me the water You give, Jesus, springing up in me to eternal life.
Help me worship You in spirit and in truth.
Make it my food to do Your will and the work You give me.

43.5.text: Jesus, You told a sick man to walk, and he was made well. I trust You in my need.
Let me hear Your word, Jesus, and believe the Father who sent You, and have eternal life.

43.6.text: Jesus, when I am afraid in the storm, say to me, it is I, do not be afraid.
Jesus, You are the bread of life. I come to You and believe in You.
Lord, I have nowhere else to go. You have the words of eternal life.

43.7.text: Jesus, give me a desire to do God's will, so that I know Your teaching is from Him.
Keep me from judging by outward appearances. Help me judge justly.
I am thirsty, Jesus. I come to You to drink.

43.8.text: Jesus, You told the woman, neither do I condemn you. Forgive me, and help me sin no more.
Jesus, You are the light of the world. Help me follow You and not walk in darkness.
Jesus, set me free, for when the Son sets us free, we are free indeed.

43.9.text: Let the works of God be displayed in me.
Open my eyes, Lord, so that I can say, I was blind, but now I see.
Lord, I believe. Help me worship You as the man did whose eyes You opened.

43.10.text: Thank You, good shepherd, for laying down Your life for Your sheep.
Make me one of Your sheep, who listen to Your voice and follow You.
Thank You that no one can snatch Your sheep out of Your hand.

43.11.text: Jesus, You are the resurrection and the life. I believe in You.
Thank You, Jesus, that You wept. Comfort all who weep today.
Help me believe, Lord, so that I see the glory of God.

43.12.text: Jesus, let me serve You, follow You, and be where You are.
Keep me from loving praise from people more than praise from God.
Thank You, Jesus, for coming as a light, so that those who believe do not remain in darkness.

43.13.text: Thank You, Jesus, that You love Your own to the very end.
Jesus, You washed Your disciples' feet. Teach me to serve others as You did.
Let our love for one another show everyone that we are Your disciples.

43.14.text: Thank You that You are preparing a place for me, so that I may be where You are.
Jesus, You are the way, the truth and the life. Bring me to the Father through You.
Father, let the Holy Spirit teach me and remind me of everything Jesus has told us.

43.15.text: Help me remain in You, Jesus, for apart from You I can do nothing.
Thank You, Jesus, that You love me as the Father loves You. Help me remain in Your love.
Jesus, You chose Your disciples and appointed them to bear fruit. Help me bear fruit that will last.

43.16.text: Guide me by the Spirit of truth into all truth.
Teach me to ask in Your name, Jesus, so that my joy may be complete.
Thank You, Jesus, that You have overcome the world. Give me courage and peace in You.

43.17.text: Father, help me know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You sent.
Father, keep me from the evil one while I live in the world.
Make us one, Father, as You and Jesus are one, so that the world may believe.

43.18.text: Lord, when I am asked if I am Your disciple, give me courage not to deny You.
Jesus, Your kingdom is not of this world. Help me to live for it.
Let me belong to the truth and listen to Your voice, Jesus.

43.19.text: Jesus, You cared for Your mother even on the cross. Teach me to care for my family.
Jesus, knowing everything was accomplished, You said, it is finished. Thank You for the cross.
Take away my fear of people, so that I do not follow You only in secret.

43.20.text: Jesus, You are my Lord and my God.
Help me be one of those who have not seen and yet have believed.
Help me believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life in His name.

43.21.text: Thank You, Jesus, for feeding Your disciples on the shore. Feed us too.
Lord, You know all things, and You know I love You. Help me feed Your sheep.
Keep me from comparing my path with others. Help me just follow You.

44.1.text: Let the Holy Spirit come upon me with power, and make me Your witness to the ends of the earth.
Keep us together with one accord, continuing in prayer, as those first believers did.
Lord, You know every heart. When we must choose, show us the one You have chosen.

44.2.text: I call on Your name, Lord. Thank You that everyone who calls on it will be saved.
Thank You, God, that You raised Jesus from the dead, for death could not keep Him in its grip.
Help me devote myself to the apostles' teaching, to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

44.3.text: Help me give what I have in the name of Jesus Christ, even when I have no silver or gold.
Give me faith in the name of Jesus, the faith that comes through Him.
I turn back to You, Lord. Wipe away my sins, and send times of refreshing from Your presence.

44.4.text: Thank You that salvation is in Jesus alone, for there is no other name by which we must be saved.
Give me boldness, though I am an ordinary person, so that others see that I have been with Jesus.
Lord, enable me, Your servant, to speak Your word with complete boldness.

44.5.text: Make me one who obeys You, God, rather than people.
Thank You for exalting Jesus to Your right hand as Savior, to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins.
Help me never stop telling the good news that Jesus is the Christ, day after day.

44.6.text: Fill those who serve others with the Spirit and with wisdom.
Help us devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.
Let the word of God continue to spread, and let the number of disciples grow.

44.7.text: Fill me with the Holy Spirit, and help me look to heaven and the glory of God.
Lord Jesus, I give You my spirit. Receive it.
Lord, give me a heart that asks You not to hold sin against those who hurt me.

44.8.text: Wherever I go, Lord, help me speak Your word as those scattered believers did.
I repent of my wickedness and pray to You, Lord. Forgive the intent of my heart.
Lord, I do not always understand what I read. Send someone to guide me.

44.9.text: Lord Jesus, tell me what I must do, and give me a heart to get up and obey.
Let our church live in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
Make me always busy with works of kindness and charity.

44.10.text: Let my prayers and my gifts to the poor rise before You, God, as a memorial offering.
Thank You that You show no favoritism, and welcome from every nation those who fear You and do right.
I believe in Jesus. Thank You that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.

44.11.text: Keep me from hindering Your work, Lord, when You give the same gift to others as You gave me.
Help me abide in You, Lord, with all my heart.
Make me a good person, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith.

44.12.text: Teach us to pray to You fervently for those in prison, as the church did.
Lord, open my eyes to see when You have rescued me, and to know for sure it was You.
Let Your word continue to spread and multiply.

44.13.text: Speak by Your Holy Spirit while I worship You, and show me the work to which You call me.
Thank You that through Jesus forgiveness of sins is proclaimed, and everyone who believes is justified.
Fill me with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

44.14.text: Turn me from every worthless thing to You, the living God, who made heaven, earth and sea.
Thank You for rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, and for filling our hearts with food and gladness.
Strengthen my soul and keep me in the faith, through the hardships I meet on the way to Your kingdom.

44.15.text: God, You know the heart. Cleanse mine by faith, as You cleansed the hearts of those who believed.
I believe that it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that I am saved.
When we decide matters together, let it seem good to the Holy Spirit and to us.

44.16.text: Lord, open my heart to respond to Your message.
Teach me to pray and sing hymns to You, even at midnight, while others listen.
I believe in the Lord Jesus. Save me, and bring my household to believe in You too.

44.17.text: Help me receive teaching eagerly, and examine the Bible every day to see if what I hear is true.
Thank You, Lord of heaven and earth, for giving me life and breath and everything else.
I seek You, Lord, and I thank You that You are not far from me.

44.18.text: Lord, when I am afraid, keep me speaking of You, and be with me.
Teach me to say of my plans, I will do this if God is willing.
Give me a humble heart to be taught Your way more accurately.

44.19.text: Let the name of the Lord Jesus be held in high honor among us.
Give me the courage to confess my deeds openly, as those believers did.
Let the word of the Lord continue to spread and prevail with power.

44.20.text: Help me finish my course and complete the work You gave me, testifying to the good news of Your grace.
I commit myself to You and to the word of Your grace, which can build me up.
Teach me to help the weak, remembering that it is more blessed to give than to receive.

44.21.text: When we say goodbye, let us kneel and pray together, families and friends alike.
Teach me to say from my heart, Lord, Your will be done.
Help me tell others what You have done, so that they glorify You.

44.22.text: Who are You, Lord? Make Yourself known to me, as You did to Paul.
What should I do, Lord? Tell me all that You have appointed me to do.
Let me know Your will and hear Your voice, and make me Your witness to everyone.

44.23.text: Help me live before You, God, in all good conscience.
Keep my hope in the resurrection of the dead alive in me.
Stand near me, Lord, when I am afraid, and tell me to take courage.

44.24.text: Help me always to strive for a clear conscience before You and before people.
Thank You for friends who care for the needs of those who are in prison.
Teach me righteousness and self-control, and keep me from putting You off until I find the time.

44.25.text: Help me live so that, if I am accused falsely, I can say truthfully that I have done no wrong.
Lord, give judges the fairness to let the accused face their accusers and defend themselves.
Thank You that Jesus, who died, is alive. Help me affirm this boldly.

44.26.text: Open the eyes of those around me, so that they turn from darkness to light and receive forgiveness of sins.
Keep me from being disobedient to what You have shown me.
Thank You, God, for helping me to this day. Help me testify to small and great alike.

44.27.text: You are the God to whom I belong and whom I serve. Stand beside me, and take away my fear.
Give me faith to believe You, God, that it will be just as You have said.
Teach me to give thanks to You over my bread, even in front of everyone.

44.28.text: Teach me to show extraordinary kindness to strangers who arrive cold, wet and in need.
Thank You, God, for fellow believers who travel to meet and encourage us.
Help me to speak boldly and freely of Your kingdom, and to teach about the Lord Jesus Christ.

45.1.text: Keep me from being ashamed of the gospel, for it is Your power for salvation to everyone who believes.
Let me live by faith from start to finish, for it is written that the righteous will live by faith.
Keep me from forgetting to glorify You as God and to give You thanks.

45.2.text: Keep me from passing judgment on others while I do the same things myself.
Thank You for the riches of Your kindness, tolerance and patience. Let Your kindness lead me to repentance.
Change my heart by Your Spirit, and let me seek praise from You rather than from people.

45.3.text: I fall short of Your glory. Thank You for justifying me freely by Your grace in Christ Jesus.
Thank You for presenting Jesus as an atoning sacrifice in His blood, received through faith.
Keep me from boasting. Thank You that I am justified by faith, apart from works of the law.

45.4.text: I believe in You, who justify the ungodly. Thank You that faith is credited as righteousness.
Forgive my lawless acts and cover my sins. Blessed is the one whose sin You never count against him.
Keep me from wavering in disbelief. Make me fully persuaded that You are able to do what You have promised.

45.5.text: Thank You that through faith in our Lord Jesus Christ I have peace with You.
Thank You that hope does not disappoint, for You have poured Your love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.
Thank You that while I was still a sinner, Christ died for me.

45.6.text: Help me count myself dead to sin, but alive to You in Christ Jesus.
I present myself to You, brought from death to life, and my body as an instrument of righteousness.
Thank You that the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

45.7.text: Lord, I do not do the good I want to do. Have mercy on me and help me.
Let me delight in Your law in my inner being, Lord.
I cry out for rescue from this body of death. Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord.

45.8.text: Father, I do not know how I ought to pray. Thank You that Your Spirit helps me in my weakness.
Help me trust that You work all things together for the good of those who love You.
Thank You that nothing in all creation will separate us from Your love in Christ Jesus our Lord.

45.9.text: Christ, You are God over all, forever worthy of praise. Amen.
I depend on Your mercy, God, and not on my own desire or effort.
Thank You that those who believe in Jesus will never be put to shame.

45.10.text: Jesus is Lord. I believe in my heart that You raised Him from the dead.
Send people to preach the good news, so that those who have not heard may hear and call on You.
Let my faith grow as I hear the word of Christ.

45.11.text: I stand by faith. Keep me from arrogance, and help me continue in Your kindness.
How deep are the riches of Your wisdom and knowledge, God! Your ways are beyond tracing.
All things are from You, through You and to You. To You be the glory forever. Amen.

45.12.text: Lord, on account of Your mercy, I give You my body as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to You.
Keep me from being conformed to this world, and transform me by renewing my mind.
Make me joyful in hope, patient in affliction and persistent in prayer.

45.13.text: Help me submit to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except what is from You.
Let my love do no wrong to my neighbor, for love is the fulfillment of the law.
Clothe me with the Lord Jesus Christ, and let me make no provision for the desires of the flesh.

45.14.text: Help me accept those whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on their opinions.
Whether I live or die, I belong to You, Lord.
Let me live for Your kingdom, which is righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

45.15.text: Let what was written in the past teach me, so that through endurance and encouragement I have hope.
Help me accept others as Christ accepted me, to bring glory to God.
God of hope, fill me with joy and peace in believing. Let me overflow with hope by the Holy Spirit.

45.16.text: Thank You for the women who have worked very hard in the Lord. Teach me to work as they did.
Make me wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
To You, the only wise God, be glory forever through Jesus Christ. Amen.

46.1.text: You are faithful, God, and You have called me into fellowship with Your Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
Thank You that the message of the cross, foolish to some, is Your power to us who are being saved.
Thank You that we are in Christ Jesus, who is our wisdom from God, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

46.2.text: When I am with others, help me resolve to know nothing except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
Thank You for what You have prepared for those who love You, more than I can imagine.
Thank You for Your Spirit. Help me understand what You have freely given us.

46.3.text: When I plant and others water, let me remember that You, God, make it grow.
Help me build on the foundation already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Thank You that we are Your temple, and that Your Spirit dwells in us.

46.4.text: Help me be found faithful, as every steward must be.
Lord, I have nothing that I did not receive. Keep me from boasting as though I had not received it.
When I am insulted, help me to bless. When I am persecuted, help me to endure.

46.5.text: Thank You that Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
Let me keep the feast with sincerity and truth, not with malice and wickedness.

46.6.text: Thank You for washing, sanctifying and justifying me in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by Your Spirit.
Help me choose what is beneficial, and let nothing master me.
You bought me at a price. Help me glorify You with my body.

46.7.text: Thank You that each of us has our own gift from You, one this and another that.
Help me lead the life You have assigned to me and called me to.
Give me undivided devotion to You, Lord.

46.8.text: Keep knowledge from puffing me up, and teach me the love that builds up.
You, Father, are the one God, from whom all things came and for whom we exist.
Keep my freedom from becoming a stumbling block to those who are weak.

46.9.text: Teach me to become all things to all people, so that some may be saved.
Let all I do be for the sake of the gospel.
Help me train with strict discipline, not for a crown that perishes, but for one that is imperishable.

46.10.text: You are faithful. Keep me from being tempted beyond what I can bear, and give me a way out.
Help me seek the good of others, and not my own good alone.
Whether I eat or drink or whatever I do, let me do it all to Your glory.

46.11.text: Lord Jesus, You asked us to eat the bread and drink the cup in remembrance of You. Thank You.
Each time I eat this bread and drink this cup, help me proclaim the Lord's death until He comes.
Help me examine myself before I eat the bread and drink the cup.

46.12.text: Thank You that I can say Jesus is Lord. No one can, except by the Holy Spirit.
Thank You that the Spirit gives a gift to each of us for the common good.
Let there be no division among us. Help us care for one another.

46.13.text: Give me love, Lord. Without it, even giving all I own gains me nothing.
Teach me to love in such a way that I keep no account of wrongs.
I know only in part now. I trust that I will know fully, as You fully know me.

46.14.text: Teach me to pray and sing with my spirit, and with my mind also.
When we come together, let all that we bring build up the church.
Thank You that You are not a God of disorder, but of peace.

46.15.text: Thank You that Christ died for our sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day.
Thank You, God, for giving us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Make me steadfast and immovable, knowing that my labor in the Lord is not in vain.

46.16.text: Help me set aside a portion of my income every week for the collection for the saints.
Keep me alert and standing firm in the faith. Give me courage and strength.
Help me do everything in love.

47.1.text: Blessed are You, God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Father of compassion and God of all comfort.
Teach me not to trust in myself, but in You, God, who raises the dead.
You delivered Paul from deadly peril. I too place my hope in You to deliver me.

47.2.text: Help me to forgive and comfort, so that no one is overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
Thank You for always leading us in triumph in Christ, and spreading through us the fragrance of knowing You.
Keep me from selling Your word for profit. Help me speak in Christ with sincerity before You.

47.3.text: I am not competent in myself. My competence comes from You.
Be present in my life by Your Spirit, Lord, for where Your Spirit is, there is freedom.
Let me reflect Your glory with an unveiled face, and transform me into Your image.

47.4.text: I am a jar of clay holding Your treasure. Let it show that the great power is Yours, not mine.
Renew my inner self day by day, Lord, even as my outer self wastes away. Keep me from losing heart.
Help me fix my eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen and eternal.

47.5.text: Help me walk by faith and not by sight.
Help me live no longer for myself, but for Him who died for me and was raised again.
Thank You that Christ, who knew no sin, became sin for us, that in Him we might become Your righteousness.

47.6.text: Help me not to receive Your grace in vain.
Thank You that now is the time of Your favor, and now is the day of salvation.
Thank You for promising to be our Father, with us as Your sons and daughters.

47.7.text: Help me cleanse myself from everything that defiles body and spirit, and perfect holiness in the fear of God.
God, You comfort the downcast. Comfort me when my spirit is low.
Give me godly sorrow, which brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret.

47.8.text: Thank You for the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, who was rich yet became poor for our sake.
Make me eager to give, for a gift given eagerly is acceptable according to what one has.
Help me do what is right, not only in Your eyes, but also in the eyes of others.

47.9.text: Help me give what I have decided in my heart, not with regret or pressure, but as a cheerful giver.
Make all grace abound to me, so that having all I need, I may abound in every good work.
Thank You, God, for Your indescribable gift.

47.10.text: Help me take every thought captive and make it obedient to Christ.
If I boast, let me boast in You, Lord.
Keep me from commending myself. May I be commended by You, Lord.

47.11.text: Keep my mind from being led astray from simple and pure devotion to Christ.
God and Father of the Lord Jesus, You are forever worthy of praise.

47.12.text: Your grace is enough for me, Lord, and Your power is made perfect in weakness.
