Teach me to see that when I am weak, then I am strong.

47.13.text: Help me examine myself, to see whether I am in the faith.
Help us rejoice, encourage one another, be of one mind and live in peace.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the Holy Spirit's fellowship be with us.

48.1.text: Thank You that Jesus gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age.
Glory be to You, our God and Father, forever and ever. Amen.
Keep me from living to please people, for I want to be a servant of Christ.

48.2.text: Help me remember the poor, and make me eager to do so.
Thank You that I am justified by faith in Jesus Christ, and not by works of the law.
Help me live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.

48.3.text: Thank You that no one is justified by the law, but the righteous will live by faith.
Thank You, Christ, for redeeming us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us.
Thank You that in Christ Jesus we are all one, whether slave or free, man or woman, of any nation.

48.4.text: Thank You for sending Your Son when the time had fully come, that we might be adopted as Your sons.
Thank You for sending the Spirit of Your Son into our hearts, so that we can call You Father.
Work in us until Christ is formed in us.

48.5.text: Thank You, Christ, for setting us free. Help me stand firm and not return to a yoke of slavery.
Help me not to use my freedom for the flesh, but to serve others in love.
Grow the fruit of the Spirit in me: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

48.6.text: Help me carry the burdens of others, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
Keep me from growing weary of doing good, and from giving up before the harvest comes.
Let me boast in nothing but the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.

49.1.text: Blessed are You, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. In Christ You have blessed us with every spiritual blessing.
Thank You that in Christ we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses.
Enlighten the eyes of my heart, that I may know the hope of Your calling.

49.2.text: Thank You that I am saved by grace through faith. It is not from myself; it is Your gift.
I am Your workmanship, created in Christ Jesus. Lead me in the good works You prepared in advance.
Thank You that Christ Himself is our peace, who has torn down the dividing wall of hostility.

49.3.text: Thank You that through faith in Christ I may come into Your presence with boldness and confidence.
Give us power to grasp how wide, long, high and deep the love of Christ is.
You are able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, by the power at work within us.

49.4.text: Help me speak the truth in love, and grow up in every way into Christ.
When I am angry, keep me from sin, and help me not to let the sun set on my anger.
Make me kind and tenderhearted, and help me forgive others just as in Christ You forgave me.

49.5.text: Help me walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us.
Help me not to be foolish, but to understand what Your will is.
Help me always give thanks to You, Father, for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

49.6.text: Teach me to honor my father and mother.
Help me take up the shield of faith, to put out all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Teach me to pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition.

50.1.text: I am confident that You, who began a good work in me, will carry it on to completion.
Let my love abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight.
Help me conduct myself in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ.

50.2.text: Keep me from selfish ambition and empty pride, and in humility help me consider others more important than myself.
Thank You, Jesus, for emptying Yourself, taking the form of a servant, and being obedient to death on a cross.
Work in me, God, to will and to act for Your good purpose.

50.3.text: Let nothing compare with the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord.
Help me press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
Thank You that our citizenship is in heaven. Help us eagerly await our Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.

50.4.text: Teach me to rejoice in You, Lord, always.
Let Your peace, which surpasses all understanding, guard my heart and mind in Christ Jesus.
Help me think about whatever is true, honorable, right, pure, lovely and admirable.

51.1.text: Thank You for rescuing us from the dominion of darkness and bringing us into the kingdom of Your beloved Son.
Thank You that Christ is before all things, and that in Him all things hold together.
Thank You that Christ is in me, the hope of glory.

51.2.text: Thank You that in Christ are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
Having received Christ Jesus as Lord, help me walk in Him, rooted, built up and overflowing with thankfulness.
Thank You that You made us alive with Christ and forgave us all our trespasses.

51.3.text: Help me set my mind on things above, not on earthly things.
Clothe me with a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
Let the peace of Christ rule in my heart, and make me thankful.

51.4.text: Help me devote myself to prayer, watchful and thankful.
Let my speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that I know how to answer everyone.
Help me wrestle in prayer for others, that they may stand mature and fully assured in Your will.

52.1.text: Give me faith that works, love that labors, and hope that endures in our Lord Jesus Christ.
Keep my heart turned from idols, so that I serve You, the living and true God.
Help me wait for Your Son from heaven, whom You raised from the dead, Jesus our deliverer.

52.2.text: Examine my heart, God, and help me seek to please You and not people.
Help me walk in a way worthy of You, who call me into Your own kingdom and glory.
Thank You that Your word is at work in those who believe. Help me receive it as Yours.

52.3.text: Thank You, God, for the great joy I have in Your presence over those who stand firm in the Lord.
Lord, make us increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else.
Establish my heart in blamelessness and holiness before You, our God and Father.

52.4.text: Thank You that You have not called me to impurity, but to holiness.
Help me aspire to live quietly, attend to my own matters, and work with my own hands.
Jesus died and rose again. Thank You that You will bring with Him those who have fallen asleep in Him.

52.5.text: Help us encourage and build one another up.
Help me rejoice at all times, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in every circumstance.
God of peace, sanctify me completely, and keep my spirit, soul and body blameless when Jesus comes.

53.1.text: Let our faith grow more and more, and our love for one another increase.
Count us worthy of Your calling, and powerfully fulfill every good desire and work of faith in us.
Let the name of our Lord Jesus be glorified in me, and me in Him, by Your grace.

53.2.text: Thank You that You chose us from the beginning to be saved by faith in the truth.
Help me stand firm and cling to the traditions Paul taught, whether by speech or by letter.
Father, You loved us by grace and gave us eternal comfort and good hope. Encourage my heart and strengthen me.

53.3.text: You are faithful, Lord. Strengthen me, and guard me from the evil one.
Keep me from growing weary in doing good.
Lord of peace, give me peace at all times and in every way.

54.1.text: Give me love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience and a sincere faith.
Thank You that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and I receive this.
To You, the king eternal, immortal and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

54.2.text: Teach me to offer petitions, prayers, intercessions and thanks for everyone, including those in authority.
God our Savior, You want everyone to be saved and to know the truth. Help me pray for this.
Thank You for Christ Jesus, the one mediator between God and people, who gave Himself as a ransom for all.

54.3.text: Make those who lead Your church above reproach, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable and able to teach.
Help us live rightly in Your household, the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
Thank You that Jesus appeared in the flesh, was proclaimed among the nations, and was taken up in glory.

54.4.text: Help me train for godliness, which is valuable in every way, for this life and the next.
I set my hope on You, the living God, the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
Help me set an example for believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.

54.5.text: Comfort the widow who is truly in need and left alone, who hopes in You and prays night and day.
Help me provide for my own, and especially for my household.
Help me honor the elders who lead well, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.

54.6.text: Teach me godliness with contentment, for that is great gain.
Keep me from the love of money, and help me pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance and gentleness.
Keep my hope in You, God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy, and not in wealth.

55.1.text: Help me fan into flame the gift of God that is in me.
Thank You that You have not given me a spirit of fear, but of power, love and self-control.
I know whom I have believed. I am convinced You are able to guard what I entrust to You.

55.2.text: Make me strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
When I am faithless, You remain faithful, for You cannot deny Yourself.
Help me present myself approved to You, a workman unashamed, handling the word of truth accurately.

55.3.text: Lord, as You rescued Paul from all his persecutions, rescue me in my troubles.
Help me continue in what I have learned and firmly believed, knowing from whom I learned it.
Thank You that the Bible is God-breathed. Let it teach and correct me, and equip me for every good work.

55.4.text: Help me fight the good fight, finish the race and keep the faith.
Lord, stand by me and strengthen me, as You stood by Paul and strengthened him.
Rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into Your heavenly kingdom. Glory to You forever. Amen.

56.1.text: Thank You, God, who cannot lie, that You promised eternal life before time began.
Make me hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.
Help leaders hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so they can encourage others by sound teaching.

56.2.text: Thank You that the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
Let Your grace teach me to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live a sensible, upright and godly life.
Jesus, You gave Yourself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness. Make us zealous for good deeds.

56.3.text: Help me to malign no one, to be peaceable and gentle, and to show full consideration to everyone.
Thank You for saving me, not by righteous deeds I had done, but by Your mercy.
Help me, as one who believes You, take care to devote myself to good deeds.

57.1.text: Thank You for those who have faith in the Lord Jesus and love for all the saints.
Make my partnership in the faith effective, as I fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
Let my love refresh the hearts of the saints.

58.1.text: Thank You that You have spoken to us by Your Son, through whom You made the universe.
Thank You that the Son is the radiance of Your glory and the exact representation of Your nature.
Lord, the heavens will wear out like a garment, but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.

58.2.text: Help me pay closer attention to what I have heard, so that I do not drift away.
Thank You that Jesus shared our humanity to free those held in slavery by fear of death.
Jesus, You suffered when You were tempted, so You are able to help me when I am tempted.

58.3.text: Help me set my focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
Today, if I hear Your voice, do not let me harden my heart.
Help us encourage one another daily, so that none of us is hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

58.4.text: Your word is living and active. Let it search the thoughts and intentions of my heart.
Thank You that Jesus sympathizes with my weaknesses. He was tempted in every way I am, yet without sin.
I approach the throne of grace with confidence. Give me mercy and grace to help in my time of need.

58.5.text: Thank You that Jesus prayed with loud cries and tears, and You heard Him because of His reverence.
Thank You that Jesus became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him.
Help me grow to maturity, so that by constant use my senses are trained to distinguish good from evil.

58.6.text: You are not unjust, God. You will not forget our work and the love we show for Your name.
Keep me from being sluggish. Help me imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
Thank You for the hope You set before me, an anchor for my soul, firm and secure.

58.7.text: Thank You for a better hope, by which I draw near to You.
Thank You that Jesus always lives to intercede for those who draw near to God through Him.
Thank You that Jesus sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.

58.8.text: Thank You that Jesus is our high priest, seated at the right hand of Your throne in heaven.
Put Your laws in my mind and write them on my heart. Be my God, and let me be Yours.
Thank You that in the new covenant You forgive my iniquities and remember my sins no more.

58.9.text: Thank You that Christ entered once for all by His own blood, securing eternal redemption.
Purify my conscience from works of death by the blood of Christ, so that I may serve the living God.
Thank You that Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many. Help me eagerly await Him.

58.10.text: Let me draw near to You with a sincere heart, in full assurance of faith, cleansed from a guilty conscience.
Help me hold resolutely to the hope I profess, for You who promised are faithful.
Help us spur one another on to love and good deeds, and not neglect meeting together.

58.11.text: Give me faith, the assurance of what I hope for and the certainty of what I do not see.
Without faith it is impossible to please You. Help me believe You exist and reward those who earnestly seek You.
Help me look forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

58.12.text: Help me throw off every weight and the sin that entangles, and fix my eyes on Jesus.
Thank You that Your discipline is for my good, so that I may share in Your holiness.
Thank You for an unshakable kingdom. Help me worship You acceptably, with reverence and awe.

58.13.text: Lord, You are my helper, so I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?
Jesus Christ, You are the same yesterday, today and forever. I trust You with today.
God of peace, equip me with every good thing to do Your will, and work in me what pleases You.

59.1.text: Let perseverance finish its work in me, so that I may be mature and complete, lacking nothing.
I lack wisdom, so I ask You, who give generously to all without finding fault.
Make me a doer of Your word and not a hearer only.

59.2.text: Keep me from favoritism as I hold out my faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ.
Make me merciful, for mercy triumphs over judgment.
Let my faith result in action, for faith by itself, without action, is dead.

59.3.text: Lord, do not let both blessing and cursing come out of my mouth.
Let me show wisdom by my good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
Give me the wisdom from above: pure, peace-loving, gentle, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.

59.4.text: You give more grace. Keep me humble, for You oppose the proud but give grace to the humble.
I submit myself to You, God. Help me resist the devil, and let me draw near to You.
Teach me to say, if the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.

59.5.text: Make me patient until the Lord's coming, and strengthen my heart, because His coming is near.
When I suffer, help me pray. When I am cheerful, help me sing praises.
Help us confess our sins to each other and pray for each other, so that we may be healed.

60.1.text: Blessed be You, God and Father, who by great mercy gave us new birth into a living hope.
Let my faith, proven in trials, result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.
Just as You who called me are holy, make me holy in all I do.

60.2.text: Thank You for calling us out of darkness into Your marvelous light. Help us proclaim Your virtues.
When I am insulted, help me, like Jesus, not to retaliate, but to entrust myself to Him who judges justly.
Jesus, You bore our sins in Your body on the tree. Help me die to sin and live to righteousness.

60.3.text: Help me not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing.
Let Christ be Lord in my heart. Help me always be ready to explain my hope with gentleness and respect.
Thank You that Christ suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring me to God.

60.4.text: Above all, help me love others deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
Help me use whatever gift I have received to serve others, as a good steward of Your grace.
I entrust my soul to You, who made me and are faithful, and I will keep doing good.

60.5.text: I humble myself under Your mighty hand, so that in due time You may exalt me.
I give You every worry, because You care for me.
God of all grace, who called us to Your eternal glory, restore me, secure me, strengthen me and establish me.

61.1.text: Thank You that Your divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness.
Help me make every effort to add goodness, knowledge and self-control to my faith.
Help me pay attention to the word of the prophets, like a lamp shining in a dark place.

61.2.text: Keep me from false teaching, and never let me deny You.
Thank You, Lord, that You know how to rescue the godly from trials. I trust You in mine.
Keep me from turning away from the holy commandment that was passed on to me.

61.3.text: Thank You for being patient with us, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
Keep my eyes on Your promise of a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
Keep me from being carried away by error, and help me grow in the grace and knowledge of Jesus.

62.1.text: God, You are light, and in You there is no darkness at all.
Help me walk in the light. Thank You that the blood of Jesus Your Son cleanses us from all sin.
Keep me from saying I have no sin, for then I deceive myself.

62.2.text: Thank You that if I sin, I have an advocate before the Father, Jesus Christ.
Help me abide in You, and walk as Jesus walked.
Help me not to love the world or anything in it, but to keep the Father's love in me.

62.3.text: Father, what love You have given us, that we should be called Your children. Thank You.
Help me to love not only in word and speech, but in action and truth.
Even when my heart condemns me, You are greater than my heart, and You know all things.

62.4.text: Help us love one another, because love comes from You.
Thank You that You loved us, and sent Your Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Let Your perfect love drive out fear in me, for there is no fear in love.

62.5.text: Thank You that our faith is the victory that overcomes the world.
Thank You that I can know I have eternal life, as I believe in the name of Your Son.
Teach me to ask according to Your will, for You hear us when we do.

63.1.text: Let grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Jesus Christ be with us in truth and love.
Teach us that love means walking according to Your commandments, and help us walk in love.
Keep me from running ahead, and help me remain in the teaching of Christ.

64.1.text: Father, I pray that in every way those I love may prosper and enjoy good health, as their souls prosper.
Make me faithful in what I do for my brothers and sisters, especially those who are strangers to me.
Help me not to imitate what is evil, but what is good.

65.1.text: Help me contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
Help me keep myself in the love of God as I wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Thank You that You are able to keep me from stumbling and present me unblemished in Your glorious presence.

66.1.text: Help me hear and obey what is written in this prophecy, for those who do are blessed.
Jesus, You love us and have released us from our sins by Your blood. Glory and power be Yours forever.
Thank You, Jesus, that You were dead and are alive forever and ever.

66.2.text: If I have left my first love, help me repent and do the deeds I did at first.
Give me an ear to hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Help me not to fear suffering, but to be faithful, trusting Your promise of the crown of life.

66.3.text: Though my strength is little, help me keep Your word and not deny Your name.
When You rebuke and discipline me because You love me, make me earnest to repent.
I hear Your voice at the door, Lord Jesus. I open it. Come in and eat with me.

66.4.text: You are holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come.
I give You glory, honor and thanks, for You sit on the throne and live forever and ever.
I bow before You and worship You, who live forever and ever.

66.5.text: Thank You that Jesus has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.
Jesus, You are worthy, for You were slain, and by Your blood You bought people for God from every nation.
To You who sit on the throne, and to the Lamb, be praise, honor, glory and power forever and ever.

66.6.text: I do not understand all of this chapter. Thank You that it is the Lamb who opens the seals.
Thank You that each one slain for Your word was given a white robe.

66.7.text: I join the multitude from every nation, tribe and tongue, crying, salvation belongs to our God and to the Lamb.
Thank You that those from the great tribulation washed their robes white in the blood of the Lamb.
Thank You that the Lamb will shepherd Your people and lead them to springs of living water.

66.8.text: Thank You that the prayers of all the saints are offered on the golden altar before Your throne.
Lord, let my prayers rise before You, as the prayers of the saints rose with the smoke of incense.

66.9.text: Keep me from idols that cannot see or hear or walk, and give me a heart that repents.
Help me to repent of my sins and never refuse to turn from them.

66.10.text: You live forever and ever, and You created heaven, the earth and the sea, and everything in them.
Thank You that the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as You proclaimed to Your servants the prophets.

66.11.text: Thank You that the kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ.
We give thanks to You, Lord God Almighty, because You have taken Your great power and begun to reign.

66.12.text: Thank You that the salvation, power and kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ, have come.
Help me conquer the accuser by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of my testimony.
Help me keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.

66.13.text: Give me the perseverance and faith that You call Your saints to have.
Lord, this passage is a call for wisdom. Give me wisdom and insight as I read.

66.14.text: Thank You that the eternal gospel is for every nation, tribe, tongue and people.
Give me the perseverance to keep Your commandments and the faith of Jesus.
Thank You that those who die in the Lord are blessed, and rest from their labors.

66.15.text: Lord God Almighty, Your works are great and wonderful, and Your ways are just and true.
You alone are holy. Let me fear You and glorify Your name.
Thank You that all nations will come and worship before You.

66.16.text: Lord God Almighty, I praise You that Your judgments are true and just.
Help me to remain awake and clothed, ready for the day You come like a thief.

66.17.text: Lord, this chapter is hard. Give me a mind with wisdom to understand what You have shown.
Jesus, You are Lord of lords, and Your called, chosen and faithful ones will be with You. Keep me faithful.
Thank You, God, that Your words will be fulfilled.

66.18.text: Help me to come out when You call, and not share in the sins of the great city.
Teach me that great wealth can be gone in a single hour, and keep my trust in You.

66.19.text: Hallelujah! You, the Lord our God the Almighty, reign.
Let us rejoice and be glad and give You the glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come.
I want to be among those invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb, for they are blessed.

66.20.text: Help me be faithful like those who held to the testimony of Jesus and the word of God.
Thank You that the second death has no power over those who share in the first resurrection.

66.21.text: Thank You that You will dwell with us. We will be Your people, and You will be our God.
Thank You that You make all things new, and that Your words are faithful and true.
I am thirsty, Lord. Give me freely from the spring of the water of life.

66.22.text: Make me one of those who wash their robes, and have the right to the tree of life.
You say You are coming soon. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints, and with me. Amen.

daily.2 Corinthians 3:3: Write on my heart by the Spirit of the living God, and make my life a letter from Christ.

daily.2 Corinthians 4:18: Help me fix my eyes on what is unseen, not on what is seen, for the unseen is eternal.
daily.2 Corinthians 4:4: Lord, open the minds of those who cannot yet see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ.
daily.2 Corinthians 4:6: God, thank You for shining in my heart, so that I know Your glory in the face of Jesus Christ.
daily.2 Corinthians 5:10: Lord, we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ. Help me to live today with that in mind.
daily.2 Corinthians 5:17: Lord, make me live as one who is in Christ, a new creation. Thank You that the new has come.
daily.2 Corinthians 5:21: Thank You that Christ, the sinless One, was made sin for us, so in Him we might become Your righteousness.
daily.2 Corinthians 5:7: Lord, help me walk by faith and not by sight today.
daily.2 Corinthians 6:16: Living God, we are Your temple. Dwell with us and walk among us, as You said, and be our God.
daily.2 Corinthians 7:1: Help me cleanse myself from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
daily.2 Corinthians 8:9: Thank You, Lord Jesus, for Your grace: though You were rich, for my sake You became poor.
daily.2 Corinthians 9:8: God, You are able to make all grace abound to me. Let me abound in every good work.
daily.2 Peter 2:9: Lord, You know how to rescue the godly from trials. Make me godly, and rescue me in my trials.
daily.2 Peter 3:18: Let me grow in grace and in knowing Jesus Christ, my Lord and Savior. To Him be the glory forever.
daily.2 Thessalonians 2:16: Thank You, Father and Lord Jesus Christ, for loving us by grace and giving us eternal comfort and good hope.
daily.2 Thessalonians 3:16: Lord of peace, give me peace at all times and in every way. Be with all of us.
daily.2 Thessalonians 3:3: Lord, You are faithful. Strengthen me and guard me from the evil one.
daily.2 Timothy 1:7: God, You have given us a spirit of power, love and self-control, not fear. Help me live by it.
daily.2 Timothy 1:9: Thank You for saving me and calling me to a holy calling, not by my works but by Your grace.
daily.2 Timothy 2:19: Lord, You know those who are Yours. I call on Your name, so help me turn away from wrongdoing.
daily.2 Timothy 4:18: Lord, rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into Your heavenly kingdom. To You be glory forever.

daily.Acts 14:22: Strengthen my soul and help me continue in the faith through the many hardships on the way to Your kingdom.
daily.Acts 1:8: Holy Spirit, give me power to be a witness for Jesus here and to the ends of the earth.
daily.Acts 20:24: Help me finish my course and the ministry You gave me, and testify to the good news of Your grace.
daily.Acts 20:28: Help the shepherds of Your church keep watch over themselves and the flock, which You purchased with Your blood.
daily.Acts 26:18: Lord, open the eyes of people so that they may turn from darkness to light and receive forgiveness of sins.
daily.Acts 2:17: God, You said that in the last days You would pour out Your Spirit on all people. Thank You.
daily.Acts 2:38: You call us to repent and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for forgiveness. Help me repent.
daily.Acts 2:39: Thank You, Lord, that the promise belongs to us and our children, and to all whom You call to Yourself.
daily.Acts 3:19: Lord, I repent and turn back to You, so that my sins may be wiped away.
daily.Acts 4:12: Jesus, there is no other name under heaven by which we must be saved. I trust in You alone.
daily.Colossians 1:10: Help me please You in every way, bearing fruit in every good work and growing in the knowledge of God.
daily.Colossians 1:11: Lord, strengthen me with all power according to Your glorious might, so that I have full endurance and patience.
daily.Colossians 1:23: Keep me established and firm in my faith, and not moved from the hope of the gospel.
daily.Colossians 3:10: Renew my new self in knowledge, Lord, in the image of the One who created it.
daily.Colossians 3:12: Clothe me with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience, as one chosen, holy and loved by You.
daily.Colossians 3:16: Let the word of Christ dwell in me richly, and let me sing to God with gratitude in my heart.
daily.Colossians 3:17: Whatever I say or do, help me do it in the name of Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father.
daily.Colossians 4:2: Lord, help me devote myself to prayer, being watchful and thankful.

daily.Ephesians 1:4: Thank You for choosing us in Christ before the world began, to be holy and blameless in Your presence.
daily.Ephesians 1:7: Thank You for redemption through Christ's blood and the forgiveness of my trespasses, by the riches of Your grace.
daily.Ephesians 2:10: Thank You that I am Your workmanship, created in Christ Jesus. Show me the good works You prepared in advance.
daily.Ephesians 2:18: Thank You, Jesus, that through You we have access to the Father by one Spirit.
daily.Ephesians 3:16: Father, out of the riches of Your glory, strengthen me through Your Spirit in my inner being.
daily.Ephesians 3:20: God, You are able to do immeasurably more than we ask or imagine, by Your power at work in us.
daily.Ephesians 4:24: Help me put on the new self, created to be like You in true righteousness and holiness.
daily.Ephesians 4:29: Keep unwholesome talk from my mouth. Let me say only what builds up the one in need and gives grace.
daily.Ephesians 4:32: Make me kind and tenderhearted to others, forgiving them as in Christ You forgave me.
daily.Ephesians 5:2: Help me walk in love, as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us.
daily.Ephesians 5:8: Lord, I was once darkness but now I am light in You. Help me walk as a child of light.
daily.Ephesians 6:10: Lord, be my strength today. Help me to be strong in You and in Your mighty power.

daily.Zechariah 13:9: Lord, when trials test me like fire, help me to call on Your name and say, You are my God.
daily.Zechariah 9:9: I rejoice greatly in the One who comes righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey.

points.text: Lord, I hand all my work over to You, the big tasks and the small.
My ways seem pure to me, but You weigh my motives. Show me what is in my heart.
I plan my course in my heart, but You decide my steps. I trust You with them.

days.title: Give your work to the Lord

points.text: Father, give us what we need for today.
Thank You, Father, that You know what I need before I ask.
Help me seek Your kingdom and Your righteousness first, and trust You to add the rest.
Give me wisdom for the choices in front of me this week.
I commit my plans to You. Make them firm.
When I ask You, help me to ask in faith, without doubting.
Whatever I am given to do today, help me work at it with my whole being, as for You.
Give me a sincere heart in my work, even when no one is watching me.
It is the Lord Christ I am serving. Help me to remember it when work is hard.
Lord, an accurate weight is Your delight. Help me measure fairly in every sale and every deal.
Let my integrity guide me, and keep me from crooked ways.
Keep my lips from lying. Help me deal faithfully, for that is Your delight.
Teach me to be content, whatever my circumstances.
Teach me the secret of living humbly and of having plenty, in any and every situation.
Thank You, Christ, for the strength You give me for whatever I face.
Thank You for the gift of eating, drinking and finding satisfaction in all my labor.
Here is the work of my hands, with thanks. Let Your favor rest on it, and make it firm.
Satisfy me in the morning with Your loving devotion, so I may sing for joy all my days.

days.title: Give thanks for the work of your hands

plans.summary: Work, a job, a business · 3 prayer points a day
plans.title: 7 days for your work

points.text: God, I ask You for wisdom this week. Thank You that You give generously, without finding fault.
Help me to ask You in faith, without doubting.
Lord, wisdom, knowledge and understanding come from You. Give them to every student sitting an exam this week.
Help me not to be anxious. I bring all my requests to You, with thanksgiving.
Let Your peace, which goes beyond understanding, guard our hearts and our minds in Christ Jesus.
Help me to think about whatever is true, honorable and right.
Whatever I study today, help me work at it with my whole being, as for You.
It is the Lord Christ I am serving. Help me to remember it when I am tired of studying.
Give me a discerning heart and an ear that seeks out knowledge.
Lord, You never grow tired or weary. I come to You because I am tired.
You give power to the faint and increase the strength of the weak. Do this for us.
I wait on You, Lord. Renew my strength, so that I run and do not grow weary.
You have relieved my distress before. Show me grace now, and hear my prayer.
When I lie on my bed tonight, help me to search my heart and be still.
Tonight I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone keep me safe.

plans.summary: 5 days · for students, and parents praying for them
plans.title: Exam week

points.text: You said it is not good to be alone. Give me good companions, and make me a helper to others.
Let every husband and wife be united, and help me honor the marriages You have put around me.
Let husbands and wives be at ease with each other, open and not ashamed.
Teach us to submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
Teach me to nourish and cherish those You have given me, as Christ does the church.
Let each husband love his wife as himself, and each wife respect her husband.
Teach me to fear You and walk in Your ways, for blessed are those who do.
Let me eat the fruit of my own labor, and let Your blessing be on it.
Let Your blessing come to every person and home that fears You.

days.title: A home that fears the Lord

points.text: Teach husbands to treat their wives with consideration and honor, as fellow heirs of Your gift of life.
Make us like-minded and sympathetic, tenderhearted and humble with one another.
When I am insulted, keep me from answering insult with insult. Help me to bless instead.
Let a husband's heart trust in his wife, in every marriage I know.
Let me open my mouth with wisdom, with faithful instruction on my tongue.
Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting. Let me be known for fearing You.

days.title: A heart that can be trusted

points.text: Keep us continuing in brotherly love, in our homes and in Your church.
Teach me to show hospitality to strangers, and open my door to those who need a welcome.
Let marriage be honored by all, and let the marriage bed be kept pure.
Thank You that two are better than one. Give couples and friends a good return for their shared labor.
When I fall, send a companion to lift me up, and make me one who lifts up others.
Let husbands and wives keep each other warm, and be near all who are alone.
Help us not to hide Your might and wonders from the children, but to declare Your praise to them.
Let the coming generation know what You have commanded, and rise up to tell their own children.
Let the children in my life put their confidence in You, not forgetting Your works, but keeping Your commands.
Let my family hear and know that the LORD our God, the LORD, is One.
Teach me to love You with all my heart, all my soul and all my strength.
Help me write Your words on the doorposts of my house and on my gates.
Teach children to obey their parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Teach me to honor my father and mother, as You have commanded.
Keep fathers from provoking their children to wrath. Help them raise children in Your discipline and instruction.
Lord Jesus, let the little children come to You, and keep me from hindering them.
Teach me to receive the kingdom of God like a little child.
Take the children I love into Your arms, place Your hands on them and bless them.
Let the children in my family and church grow strong, be filled with wisdom, and have Your grace upon them.
Give the young people I know good teachers, and a heart to listen and to ask questions.
Let me keep growing in wisdom, and in favor with You and with people.
Have compassion on me, Lord, as a father has compassion on his children.
Thank You that You know our frame and remember that we are dust.
Let Your loving devotion rest on those who fear You, and Your righteousness on their children's children.
I sing praises to Your name. I exalt You, whose name is the LORD, and rejoice before You.
Thank You that You are a father to the fatherless and a defender of widows.
Settle the lonely in families, and show me who I can welcome in.
Clothe me with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
Let the peace of Christ rule in our hearts, and make us thankful.
Let the word of Christ dwell richly in us, and let us sing to You with gratitude.
Make us devoted to one another in love, each eager to honor the other.
Help us live in harmony. Keep me from pride and conceit, and help me keep company with the lowly.
When I am wronged, keep me from repaying evil for evil. Help me think carefully about what is right.
When I am angry, keep me from sin, and do not let my anger outlast the day.
Let no unwholesome talk come from my mouth, only what is helpful for building others up.
Take all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, and every form of malice away from me.
Keep jealousy and selfish ambition out of our home, for where they exist there is disorder.
Give me wisdom from above: pure, peace-loving, gentle, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.
Make me a peacemaker who sows in peace, and let us reap the fruit of righteousness.
Keep me from empty pride. In humility, teach me to consider others more important than myself.
Help me look not only to my own interests, but also to the interests of others.
Let the same mind be in me that was in Christ Jesus.
Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. Help me mean it.
Father, help me forgive others their trespasses, for then You will also forgive me.
Do not let me refuse to forgive others their trespasses, for I need Your forgiveness.
Build our house, Lord, for without You its builders labor in vain.
Protect our home and our town, for without You the watchmen stand guard in vain.
Let me rest in You and not toil anxiously, for You give sleep to Your beloved.

days.title: God's glory in the sky and in His word
The Lord is my light and my stronghold
Taste and see that the Lord is good
God is our refuge and strength
Thirsting for God in a dry land
A prayer of the poor and needy
Teach us to number our days
My help comes from the Lord
You know me and You are near
Teach me to do Your will
Hope in the Lord, not in princes
Let all creation praise the Lord
Sing to the Lord a new song
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord

plans.summary: One psalm a day, prayed a line at a time
plans.title: 40 days in the Psalms

points.text: Glorious Father, give me a spirit of wisdom and revelation, that I may know You.
Light up the eyes of my heart, so that I know the hope of Your calling.
Show me the surpassing greatness of Your power toward us who believe.
Out of the riches of Your glory, strengthen me with power by Your Spirit in my inner being.
Let Christ make His home in my heart through faith, and let love be my root and foundation.
Help me know the love of Christ, which is beyond knowing, and be filled with Your fullness.
Lord, You can do immeasurably more than all I ask or imagine. I bring my needs to You.
Thank You that Your power is at work within us.
Glory to You in the church and in Christ Jesus, in every generation, forever. Amen.
Let my love overflow more and more, with knowledge and deep insight.
Help me test what is best, and be pure and blameless for the day of Christ.
Fill me with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to Your glory and praise.
Help me know what You want of me, with all spiritual wisdom and understanding.
Help me walk worthy of You, Lord, and please You in every way.
Let me bear fruit in every good work and grow in knowing You.
Strengthen me with all power, according to Your glorious might.
Give me full endurance and patience, and fill me with joy.
Thank You, Father, that You have qualified me to share in the inheritance of Your people in the light.
Help me to devote myself to prayer, and to stay watchful and thankful.
Open a door for Your word, so that I may proclaim the mystery of Christ.
Help me to speak of Christ clearly, as I should.
Make me faithful to bring petitions, prayers and thanks to You for everyone.
God our Savior, it pleases You when we pray for everyone. Help me to do it.
You want everyone to be saved and to know the truth. I ask this for our leaders too.
Lord, I lift up our leaders and all who hold authority over us.
Help us to lead quiet and peaceful lives, in all godliness and dignity.
I give thanks to You for those who lead us, as I do for everyone.
Help me to submit to the governing authorities, for all authority comes from You.
Remind our leaders, Lord, that no authority exists except what comes from You.
Let those in authority be Your servants for our good.
Show me how to seek the prosperity of the place where You have sent me.
Lord, I pray on behalf of our city. Let it prosper.
Help me to remember that my city's good is my good too.

days.title: Seek the good of your city

points.text: Let the righteous flourish among us, Lord, so that the people rejoice.
Teach our leaders to rule with justice, which brings stability to the land.
Help our leaders, and help me, to consider the cause of the poor.
Let righteousness lift up our nation, Lord, and let it begin with me.
Forgive us, Lord, for the sin that is a disgrace to any people.
Make me kind to the needy, for kindness to them honors You.
Lord, we ask that our nation will have You as its God. Blessed is such a nation.
Teach our leaders, and all of us, to trust You and not our own strength.
Lord, as we put our hope in You, let Your loving devotion rest on us.

plans.title: For our country and its leaders

points.text: Bless the Lord, my soul. With all that is within me, I bless His holy name.
Help me not to forget any of Your kind deeds.
Lord, You are great and worthy of praise. Your greatness is beyond my understanding.
I enter Your gates with thanksgiving and Your courts with praise.
You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power.
You created all things, and by Your will they exist. I praise You.
I confess my sins to You. You are faithful and just to forgive me.
Cleanse me from all unrighteousness, Lord.
Create in me a clean heart, God, and renew a right spirit within me.
I will not hide my wrong from You. I acknowledge my sin.
I confess my wrongdoing to You, Lord. Forgive the guilt of my sin.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know my concerns.
See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
I give thanks to You, Lord, for You are good. Your loving devotion endures forever.
Teach me to give thanks in every circumstance, for this is Your will for me.
Thank You for all Your kind deeds. I will not forget them.
As I bring my requests to You, let me do it with thanksgiving.
Thank You for what You have already done, even while I wait.
Thank You in the hard days as well as the easy ones.
I pray for everyone today, with petitions, prayers, intercessions and thanks.
Bless our leaders, so that we may lead quiet and peaceful lives in all godliness.
Lord, I pray for those in authority over us.
Make my town prosper. I pray to You on its behalf.
Help me seek the good of the place where You have put me.
Let my heart's desire and prayer be for the salvation of others.
Give words to those who preach the gospel, so that they speak it boldly.
Father, give us today our daily bread, and teach me to trust You for tomorrow.
Let Your favour rest on me, and establish the work of my hands.
I commit my work and my plans to You. Bring them to good ends.
Help me work with my whole heart, as for You and not only for people.
Keep my scales honest and my dealings clean, even when no one is checking.
Teach me to be content, in a month of plenty and in a month of little.
Make me skilled in my work.
Help me honor You with my wealth and with the first of all I earn.
I ask, I seek, I knock. Open the right door for me.
I trust You with all my heart, and I will not lean on my own understanding.
In all my ways I acknowledge You. Make my paths straight.
I commit my way to You, Lord. I trust that You will do it.
Supply all my needs according to Your glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
Keep me from giving up. Help me keep asking, seeking and knocking.
I lack wisdom for what is in front of me. Give it to me generously.
Keep my scales honest and my dealings clean, even when no one is checking.
Let my weights and measures be accurate, for that is Your delight.
I commit my work to You, Lord. Establish my plans.
Make me skilled in my trade, like the worker who serves in the presence of kings.
Make me generous, Lord, for You tell us to give.
Help me use a fair measure with everyone, for the measure I use is measured back to me.
Keep me from dishonest scales, which are an abomination to You.
Lord, send rain on our land in its season, the early rains and the late.
Open the heavens, Your abundant storehouse, and bless all the work of our hands.
Soak the furrows, soften the soil, and crown this year with Your goodness.
Give me patience while the crop grows, like the farmer who waits for the rains.
Keep me from growing weary of doing good, in my fields and everywhere. Help me not to give up.
Help me know the state of my animals and care for them well.
Thank You that seedtime and harvest will not stop while the earth remains.
Supply all my needs according to Your glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
Help me owe no one anything, except the debt of love.
Keep my life free from the love of money, and make me content with what I have.
Thank You that You will never leave me or forsake me.
Keep falsehood and lies far from me.
Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the bread that is my portion.
Keep me from having so much that I forget You, or so little that I steal.
I lack wisdom for my studies. You give generously to all who ask, so I ask.
Lord, You give wisdom, knowledge and understanding. Give them to me for my exams.
As You gave knowledge and understanding to four young men, give them to me.
Give me insight and understanding in every kind of study.
Help me study with my whole being, as for You and not only for people.
Guard my heart and my mind with Your peace on the day of the exam.
I am anxious about my exam. I bring it to You in prayer, with thanksgiving.
I commit this matter to You and trust You. Bring forth my justice like the noonday sun.
Help me act justly, love mercy and walk humbly with You.
Thank You for showing me what is good.
Let justice be done, and let it be a joy to the righteous.
Teach me to do right and to seek justice.
Help me defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow.
Bring forth the justice of those who are wronged, like the noonday sun.
Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved.
You are my praise, even in sickness. I turn to You.
Sustain me on my bed of illness, and restore me from my bed of sickness.
Lord, sustain the one who is sick, and restore them from their bed of illness.
When I am sick, help me call for the elders of the church to pray over me.
May the prayer offered in faith restore the one who is sick.
Thank You for doctors, nurses and health workers who care for the sick.
Lead me to the care I need, for the sick need a doctor.
Lord, hear my prayer, as You heard Isaac when he prayed for his wife.
Hear the prayer of every husband and wife who waits for a child.
I ask You for a child. Grant me what I ask, as You granted Hannah.
You settle the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother. I ask this for my home.
Thank You that children are a heritage from You.
Teach me to see every child as Your gift and Your reward.
Help me train my children in the way they should go.
May my children not depart from Your way when they are old.
Let Your words be upon my heart, before I teach them to my children.
Help me talk about Your words at home, on the road, when I lie down and when I get up.
Make me diligent in teaching Your words to my children, day by day.
Let all my children be taught by You, Lord, and prosper.
Let my children walk in the truth. I have no greater joy than that.
Help us bear with one another and forgive any complaint, as You forgave us.
Clothe us in love, which binds us together in perfect unity.
Teach husbands to love their wives as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her.
Make our love patient and kind, not envious, boastful or proud.
Keep us from rudeness and self-seeking, and from being easily angered.
Let our love bear all things, believe all things, hope all things and endure all things.
Bind us together, Lord, like a cord of three strands that is not quickly broken.
Teach me to delight in You, and hear the desires of my heart.
I commit my way to You and trust in You.
You are a sun and a shield. Keep me walking with integrity while I wait.
I trust that You withhold no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
I know that a good marriage is a favor from You.
I trust that a prudent wife is a gift from You, Lord.
If it is possible on my part, help me live at peace with everyone.
Give me humility, gentleness and patience, bearing with others in love.
Help us keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
Help me give a gentle answer that turns away anger.
Keep my tongue from harsh words that stir up anger.
As for me and my house, we will serve You, Lord.
Let this be a house that serves the Lord.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
I cast all my anxiety on You, because You care for me.
You are with me, so I will not fear. You are my God.
Strengthen me, help me, and uphold me with Your righteous right hand.
Give me Your peace. You do not give as the world gives.
Do not let my heart be troubled or afraid.
Remind me that You care for me.
Lord, You are near to the brokenhearted. Be near to me now.
You say those who mourn will be comforted. Comfort me.
I mourn, and I come to You for comfort.
Father of compassion and God of all comfort, comfort me in my sorrow.
Comfort us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort others.
I look to the day when You will wipe away every tear from our eyes.
There will be no more death, mourning, crying or pain. Thank You for that hope.
I trust in You with all my heart and do not lean on my own understanding.
In all my ways I acknowledge You. Make my paths straight.
Instruct me and teach me the way I should go.
Give me counsel and watch over me.
Let me hear Your voice behind me when I turn right or left: this is the way, walk in it.
Let Your word be a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Because of Your loving devotion I am not consumed, and Your mercies never fail.
Your mercies are new every morning. Great is Your faithfulness!
Help me not to call to mind the former things.
Make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
Thank You that in Christ I am a new creation. The old has passed away.
Help me forget what is behind and strain toward what is ahead.
I press on toward the goal of Your heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
Let me dwell in the shelter of the Most High and rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.
Guard me from all evil, Lord, and preserve my soul.
Watch over my coming and going, now and forevermore.
Watch over my family as they come and go.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone make me dwell in safety.
Your name is a strong tower. I run to it and am safe.
I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection.
Help me grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
Fill me with the knowledge of Your will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding.
Help me walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, bearing fruit in every good work.
Strengthen me with power through Your Spirit in my inner being.
Let Christ dwell in my heart through faith, and let me be rooted in love.
Help me to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge.
Make me strong in You and in Your mighty power, not in my own.
Clothe me in Your full armour, so that I can stand.
Remind me that my struggle is not against people, not my relatives or neighbours, but against the powers of darkness.
I submit to You. Help me resist the devil, and he will flee.
Thank You that the One who is in me is greater than the one who is in the world.
Thank You that Christ disarmed the powers and authorities and triumphed over them by the cross.
Help me stand against the devil's schemes.
Christ made a public spectacle of the powers by the cross. I stand in His victory.
